title: QA Tester - iPhone app + website
description:
We are hiring 1-2 detail-oriented QA testers for Carby, a meal-planning iPhone app and website. This is not just a basic bug-checking role. We want someone who can go through the full user experience, notice confusing 
nts, and write clear improvement suggestions.



This starts with a short interview exercise. The best reports will be hired for ongoing weekly QA work.



Requirements:

- You have access to a real iPhone.

- You can record your iPhone screen with microphone audio on.

- You write clear English.

- You can create a clean Google Doc report with screenshots, recordings, repro steps, and severity.

- You can test both a website and an iOS app.



To apply, start your application with the word MANGO and answer:

1. What iPhone model and iOS version do you have?

2. What QA/testing experience do you have?

3. Share one bug or confusing UX problem you found in any app or website, with repro steps in 2-3 sentences.

4. Are you comfortable recording your screen with voice narration and creating a Google Doc report?



Applications that do not start with MANGO will not be considered. This is an attention-to-detail test.



Qualified applicants will receive a short interview exercise through a Tally form. The interview exercise includes:

- 30-second tech-check screen recording with microphone on.

- One continuous narrated iPhone Safari test of the Carby quiz flow.

- A $0 tester checkout flow.

- Downloading and exploring the Carby iOS app.

- A Google Doc report with device, flow tested, expected vs actual behavior, repro steps, screenshots/recordings, severity P0-P3, UX friction, and suggested fixes.



Auto-fail for the interview exercise: no tech-check video, full recording has no audio, chat notes instead of a Google Doc, or missed deadline.

title: Meta Media Buyer
description:
About Lucyd



Lucyd is a performance marketing and growth agency helping ambitious wellness brands scale through acquisition, retention, creative strategy, and conversion optimization.



We specialize in building scalable growth systems for brands operating in policy-constrained wellness, including hemp, cannabis, telehealth (including GLP-1s and research peptides), supplements, and functional wellness products.



We are more than an agency executing individual services. We operate as integrated growth partners embedded in our clients’ businesses, helping them solve challenges across the entire customer journey—from customer acquisition and retention to creative, websites, and conversion optimization.



Our team moves quickly, communicates transparently, and operates with a high level of ownership and accountability. We care deeply about outcomes, strategic thinking, operational excellence, and long-term client partnerships.



---



Why This Role Exists



The Media Buyer, Paid Social is responsible for bringing growth strategies to life through exceptional execution on Meta.



Working closely with a Growth Strategist, you’ll build, launch, optimize, and scale paid social campaigns that drive profitable growth for our clients. You’ll combine strong platform expertise with analytical thinking to make informed optimization decisions, uncover opportunities through data, and continuously improve campaign performance.



This role is ideal for someone who enjoys executing at a high level, thrives in fast-paced environments, and takes pride in operational excellence.



---



Working in Complex Advertising Environments



Lucyd specializes in helping brands grow in industries where advertising is rarely straightforward.



Many of our clients operate in highly regulated or policy-constrained categories, including hemp-derived cannabinoids, cannabis-adjacent products, telehealth services, GLP-1s, peptides, supplements, and functional wellness products.



Success in these industries requires more than platform expertise. It requires curiosity, adaptability, strategic thinking, and a willingness to challenge conventional approaches while operating within evolving platform policies.



We are looking for someone who enjoys solving complex advertising challenges and can consistently find innovative ways to help clients scale responsibly.



---



What You’ll Own



Campaign Execution & Optimization



- Build, launch, manage, and optimize Meta advertising campaigns across a portfolio of DTC ecommerce clients.

- Execute testing plans across audiences, creatives, placements, budgets, and campaign structures.

- Monitor campaign performance daily and make data-driven optimization decisions that improve efficiency and profitability.

- Manage campaign budgets and pacing while maintaining alignment with client performance goals.

- Troubleshoot campaign delivery issues, tracking discrepancies, and platform-related challenges.



Performance Analysis



- Analyze campaign performance using Meta Ads Manager and supporting analytics platforms.

- Identify trends across creative, messaging, audiences, offers, and funnel performance.

- Understand *why* creative is succeeding or underperforming, using performance data to generate actionable insights.

- Monitor key performance metrics including MER, aMER, CAC, bCAC, CPA, CPM, and other leading indicators.

- Prepare performance updates and reporting for internal stakeholders and client-facing meetings.



Cross-Functional Collaboration



- Partner closely with Growth Strategists to execute paid media strategies across assigned accounts.

- Collaborate with Creative teams by providing data-backed recommendations for new concepts, messaging angles, hooks, offers, and creative testing opportunities.

- Contribute ideas during creative strategy discussions while helping ensure creative testing aligns with account priorities.

- Communicate proactively with internal teams regarding campaign performance, blockers, and opportunities.

- Participate in client calls as needed and communicate confidently in written client updates.



---



What Success Looks Like



Successful Media Buyers consistently:



- Execute campaigns accurately, efficiently, and with exceptional attention to detail.

- Achieve client MER, aMER, CAC and bCAC goals through disciplined optimization and testing.

- Move quickly while maintaining a high standard of quality.

- Communicate proactively and collaborate effectively across teams.

- Complete work reliably, follow established processes, and demonstrate strong operational excellence.

- Use data to identify opportunities, solve problems, and improve performance over time.



---



What You Bring to the Table



Required



- 3+ years of experience managing Meta advertising for DTC ecommerce brands.

- Agency experience managing multiple client accounts simultaneously.

- Experience managing six-figure monthly Meta advertising budgets.

- Strong understanding of Meta Ads Manager, campaign structure, audience strategy, and optimization best practices.

- Experience working with Shopify and/or WooCommerce ecommerce brands.

- Ability to analyze creative performance and identify the drivers behind winning and losing campaigns.

- Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret campaign data and make informed optimization decisions.

- Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Strong written communication skills and comfort participating in client meetings when needed.

- Experience working successfully in a remote environment.

- Ability to manage competing priorities while maintaining quality and meeting deadlines.



Preferred



- Experience working with third-party attribution platforms such as Triple Whale, Northbeam, Hyros, or similar.

- Experience advertising within policy-constrained wellness industries, including hemp, cannabis, telehealth (GLP-1s, peptides), supplements, and functional wellness.

- Experience managing campaigns on TikTok, X, or Snapchat.

- Familiarity with GA4 and ecommerce analytics.

- Experience collaborating closely with creative teams on performance marketing initiatives.



---



Who Thrives at Lucyd



Successful Paid Social Media Buyers at Lucyd are proactive, detail-oriented operators who enjoy turning strategy into execution.



They are analytical, adaptable, and naturally curious about what drives performance. They communicate clearly, take ownership of their work, and move quickly without sacrificing quality. They thrive in collaborative environments, enjoy solving complex problems with data, and embrace continuous learning as advertising platforms evolve.

, or similar.

Apply now. It takes 5 minutes.

I am looking for a highly organized and dependable Virtual Assistant to help me stay on top of administrative work, client follow-ups, scheduling, and internal task management.



This is not a creative role or a one-time project. I want someone interested in stable, long-term work who enjoys structure, checklists, organization, and closing open loops.



You will work directly with me. Your primary responsibility will be making sure administrative tasks, follow-ups, and deadlines do not get lost.



## Initial Responsibilities



### Task and Schedule Management



* Review
s and messages that I identify for follow-up

* Convert requests into clear tasks

* Maintain my task list

* Track deadlines and outstanding items

* Send reminders when something is overdue

* Prepare a short daily priority summary



### Client Follow-Up



* Send appointment confirmations

* Follow up on unanswered
s

* Request missing information from clients

* Help schedule meetings and service appointments

* Track items waiting on clients, vendors, or technicians



### Autotask Administration



* Review assigned tickets for missing information

* Update ticket contacts, statuses, and administrative notes

* Identify tickets that appear stalled or require my attention

* Keep ticket information organized

* Help close completed administrative items



### Billing and Documentation Support



As the role develops, responsibilities may include:



* Reviewing invoices before they are sent

* Checking billable time and service information

* Flagging missing or inconsistent billing details

* Updating client contacts, vendors, renewal dates, and service records

* Organizing internal procedures and documentation



## Required Skills and Traits



* Excellent written English

* Strong attention to detail

* Reliable attendance and consistent availability

* Strong organization and follow-through

* Comfortable using calendars, spreadsheets,
, and business software

* Able to follow written procedures carefully

* Willing to ask questions instead of guessing

* Comfortable sending reminders and following up repeatedly when necessary



You should enjoy being the person who keeps information organized and makes sure tasks are completed.



## Preferred Experience



The following experience is helpful but not required:



* Virtual assistant or executive assistant work

* Managed IT services or help desk environments

* Autotask, HaloPSA, Zendesk, or another ticketing system

* Billing or invoicing support

* Supporting a business owner

* Microsoft 365, Outlook, Excel, and Teams



## Work Details



* $5 USD per hour

* Approximately 1–2 hours per weekday

* Monday through Friday

* Long-term position

* Hours may increase as trust and responsibilities grow

* A paid test task will be required before hiring

* Work activity and time must be documented



## How to Apply



Begin your application with this exact phrase:



**“CySec runs on systems, not chaos.”**



Then provide:



1. A short paragraph explaining why this role fits you

2. One example of a business process, task list, inbox, ticket queue, or administrative system you helped organize

3. Your normal working hours and time zone

4. A description of your computer and internet reliability

5. Any experience with MSPs, IT companies, ticket systems, or invoicing

6. Confirmation that you accept the $5 USD hourly rate



Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be reviewed.



## Final Note



This role requires ownership, consistency, and accountability. I am not looking for someone who simply waits for individual instructions.



I want someone who learns the procedures, keeps track of open items, follows up appropriately, and helps ensure the business runs in an organized manner.

title: Junior Project Manager (Asana)
description:
We are a premium group travel company that has spent 18 years designing curated, done-for-you travel experiences for our community. Behind every trip is a team working across dozens of projects at once, and we run it all in Asana. We're hiring a Junior Project Manager to help keep those projects moving, on time, and visible to everyone who needs them.



What You'll Do

You'll work directly with our Project Manager as her backup and right hand. Your areas of work will include:

- Turning written briefs into organized projects and tasks in Asana

- Building project timelines backward from fixed deadlines (our trips depart on set dates, so deadlines do not move)

- Tracking dependencies across projects and flagging risks early, before they become emergencies

- Checking in on active projects and keeping boards accurate and up to date

- Running and posting status reports so leadership always knows where things stand

- Posting updates, reminders, and recaps in Slack, and turning meetings into action items with owners and due dates

- Following up with tea
mbers on deadlines and keeping work on track with a positive, encouraging approach

- Keeping project documentation and SOPs current as our processes evolve

- Supporting the tools that connect to Asana, including Zapier automations and AI tools like Claude



What We're Looking For

Required:

- Strong hands-on Asana experience: creating projects, building out tasks, assigning work, setting due dates, and using views and reporting

- Real project management fundamentals: sequencing tasks, understanding dependencies and critical path, and working backward from a hard deadline

- Ability to juggle multiple projects at once and prioritize when everything feels urgent

- A proactive eye for risk: you notice when something is starting to slip and raise it early, with a suggested fix, instead of waiting to be asked

- Daily working comfort in Slack

- Fluent spoken AND written English

- Confident, professional written communication. You will be following up with tea
mbers about deadlines, so you need to be clear, warm, and persistent

- Sharp attention to detail and strong organizational instincts

- Reliable full-time availability during U.S. Eastern business hours



Nice to have:

- Formal PM training or certification (CAPM, Google Project Management Certificate, or similar)

- Experience in travel, events, or another industry where the deadline cannot move

- Exposure to Zapier or other automation tools

- Exposure to AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) for drafting reports and summaries

- Exposure to Airtable, Google Workspace, or Keap

- Experience holding a team accountable to deadlines as a PM, coordinator, or team lead



Details

Type: Full-time (40 hours/week)

Pay: $800/month



Schedule: Near-full overlap with U.S. Eastern business hours, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM ET (New York)

Long-term: We are hiring for a long-term role with a stable, established company. We invest in training and SOPs for the people we bring on.



How to Apply

Complete our application form here: 
 



Applications that skip the Google Form will not be reviewed.

title: Customer Support & Sales Specialist (Non-Voice, Full-Time, European Shift)
description:
ABOUT TODAY2REPAIR



Today2Repair is a fast-growing electronics repair brand based in the Netherlands. We have built a large online audience through practical and entertaining social media content. Customers from across the Netherlands and Belgium visit us or send us their devices for repair.



We currently focus mainly on PlayStation consoles and controllers. Our customers contact us through WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, and email with questions about repairs, prices, appointments, shipping, and order updates.



Instagram: www.instagram.com/today2repair/

TikTok: www.tiktok.com/@today2repair



ABOUT THE ROLE



We are hiring a full-time Customer Support & Sales Specialist based in the Philippines. This is a permanent, non-voice role focused on written customer communication and inbound sales.



You will be responsible for helping customers, qualifying repair requests, explaining the correct options, booking appointments, arranging shipping, and following up with leads. Your job is not simply to answer messages quickly. You must understand the conversation, provide accurate information, and guide the customer towards the right next step.



Our customers communicate in Dutch. You do not need to speak Dutch. You will write clear English source messages and use our DeepL and AI-assisted translation workflow. Excellent written English and careful proofreading are therefore essential.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Manage incoming WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, and email conversations in GoHighLevel.

- Read the full conversation before replying and make sure every customer question is answered.

- Qualify repair requests and provide accurate information from our approved pricing and repair knowledge base.

- Recommend the right repair option without pressuring or misleading customers.

- Turn qualified inquiries into appointments, shipping labels, or confirmed next steps.

- Create and update appointments, contact details, notes, and pipeline stages in GoHighLevel.

- Follow up with customers who received a price but did not yet book or ship their device.

- Check model, compatibility, stock, price, and expected repair time before making a commitment.

- Escalate technical exceptions, complaints, uncertain diagnoses, and unusual pricing questions.

- Provide a clear handover at the end of every shift for conversations that still need action.

- Help improve templates, FAQs, and SOPs when you notice repeated questions or unclear processes.

- Prioritize clearing the Sunday backlog when your Monday shift begins.



WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT



- This is not cold calling.

- This is not a general operations, finance, or project-management position.

- This is not a copy-paste role where speed matters more than accuracy.

- You should never guess a price, diagnosis, stock status, or appointment time.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- Excellent written English with strong grammar, spelling, and sentence structure.

- At least 1-2 years of relevant experience in non-voice customer support, chat support, inbound sales, e-commerce support, or appointment setting.

- Strong attention to detail, especially with prices, dates, names, model numbers, and order details.

- Able to communicate in a friendly, concise, and confident way.

- Comfortable using AI and translation tools while still checking the final result yourself.

- Able to follow SOPs and approved templates without sounding robotic.

- Commercial awareness: you recognize buying intent and confidently suggest a concrete next step.

- Calm and accurate during busy periods with many simultaneous conversations.

- Reliable computer, stable internet connection, and a backup plan for internet or power interruptions.

- Able to work the stated Philippine night shift and Saturday schedule consistently.



Experience with GoHighLevel, Slack, Google Workspace, ClickUp, DeepL, or CRM systems is helpful, but training will be provided.



WORKING HOURS AND COMPENSATION



- Monday through Saturday, with Sunday as your fixed day off.

- 12:00 PM to 9:00 PM Netherlands time, with a one-hour break (8 working hours per day).

- Approximately 6:00 PM to 3:00 AM Philippine time during Dutch summer time and 7:00 PM to 4:00 AM during Dutch winter time.

- USD 800-1,000 fixed monthly salary, depending on experience and assessed skill level.

- Paid onboarding and training.

- Long-term position with room to take ownership and grow.



This is a permanent Philippine night-shift position. Please apply only if this schedule is sustainable for you over the long term.



HOW SUCCESS WILL BE MEASURED



After training, we will measure:



- At least 90% of new inquiries answered within 30 minutes during staffed hours.

- No actionable lead left unattended for more than 60 minutes without a documented reason.

- Accurate prices, dates, appointments, model information, and next steps.

- A customer-service quality score of at least 90?sed on weekly conversation reviews.

- Every active conversation has the correct owner, notes, and pipeline status.

- Clear daily handovers with no silently abandoned conversations.

- Improvement in the percentage of qualified leads that become appointments or shipping orders.



We value quality and judgment as much as speed. A fast but incorrect answer is not a good answer.



YOUR FIRST 30 DAYS



- Learn our services, products, prices, repair options, tone of voice, and escalation rules.

- Complete written product and customer-service assessments.

- Shadow real conversations and handle replies with review and feedback.

- Learn GoHighLevel, our translation workflow, templates, pipeline, and daily handover process.

- Gradually take ownership of your shift and reach the agreed response-time and quality standards.



HOW TO APPLY



Do not send your application through OnlineJobs. Complete our application form instead:



docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfcFvDV61GJ0a4p4XFcMmkCvOdTMra1yCGBQ8HPhL9zdm0B1g/viewform?usp=dialog



The form includes written customer scenarios, availability questions, and a short video introduction. Applications submitted outside the form will not be reviewed.

title: Shopify CRO & Analytics Specialist (Furniture DTC Brand)
description:
About Us



We are a growing DTC furniture brand focusing on handcrafted rattan and wood bedroom pieces for US customers ONLY. 

We already have profitable Meta ads(ROAS=4), but our website conversion rate is still low. We are looking for a long?term partner who can help us turn good traffic into more sales through better data, smarter UX, and continuous site optimization.



Role Summary



You will be responsible for improving our website conversion rate across the full funnel: from landing page, to product page, to checkout. This is a hands?on role: you will analyze data, propose changes, and work with our team to implement and test them in Shopify.



Key Responsibilities



- Analyze Shopify, GA4 and Meta ad data to understand user behavior and conversion drop?off points.

- Build and maintain basic dashboards/reports (Shopify, GA4, Meta) so the team can see performance by channel, landing page, device and funnel step.

- Audit our current site (home page, collection pages, product pages, cart, checkout) and propose CRO improvements with clear priorities.

- Work with our designer/developer (or theme editor) to implement changes in Shopify (layouts, sections, copy, trust elements, etc.). If you can do it, that's a plus!

- Plan and run simple experiments (A/B or sequential tests) on key elements: hero section, product page layout, reviews section, FAQ, sticky add?to?cart, offers, etc.

- Help ensure tracking is correct (events, UTM structure, pixel/CAPI, GA4 events) to avoid data loss or mis?attribution.

- Prepare short, clear weekly summaries: “what we tested, what we learned, next steps.”



Must?Have Skills & Experience



2+ years experience in e?commerce or DTC, ideally on Shopify.

Practical experience with GA4, Meta Ads reporting, and Shopify analytics.

Strong analytical skills: comfortable with funnels, conversion rates, cohorts, and basic Excel/Google Sheets.

Familiar with CRO concepts: user journeys, trust elements, social proof, landing page best practices.

Able to write clear English in a structured way (for reports, test plans, and internal communication).

Detail?oriented and very execution?focused: you don’t just suggest ideas, you help push them live and measure results.



Nice?To?Have



Experience with furniture, home goods or other high?ticket products.

Experience with heatmap/session tools (e.g. Hotjar, Clarity, Mida).

Experience with A/B testing tools or Shopify testing apps.

Comfortable using AI tools to speed up research, copy suggestions, or data analysis.



Working Arrangement



Remote, long?term cooperation.

Hours: 80–120 hours per month to start (part?time / heavy part?time), with potential to grow into more hours as we scale.

Or we can based on project and see how it goes.



Time zone: we work mainly in China time, but we are flexible as long as you can join key calls and deliver on deadlines.





How to Apply



Please send:



A short introduction (3–5 paragraphs) about your experience with Shopify and CRO.

1–2 examples of websites you helped improve (before/after or a short story of what you did).

If you can show more of the work report as a proof, that would be great.

This is not just “making things look nice.” The goal is to create thumbnails that grab attention, communicate the idea quickly, and make people want to click while staying aligned with the channel’s style and strategy.

• Strong understanding of YouTube thumbnails and the psychology of what makes people click

• Clear communication skills in English

title: Amazon Operations and Team Manager| 3+ Years Experience
description:
Who We Are

BTS Brands is an 8-year-old private label company selling across US, CA, UK, EU, AU, JP and expanding into Saudi Arabia. We operate across two brands: one in travel accessories and one in beauty devices, with 52+ active SKUs. We're at a turning point: moving from a founder-run business to a properly managed, systems-run company. This role is central to that transition.



The Role

This is not a VA role. This is an operations and team management position for someone who has done this before in an ecommerce or Amazon environment.



You will report directly to the two Founders and manage a team of 8-9 people across our Creative and Operations teams. You'll take our existing processes - currently scattered and undocumented - and build a proper system in ClickUp from scratch. You'll create SOPs, track KPIs, run tea
etings, and make sure everyone knows what they're doing and when.



Your mission is to build the systems, rhythm, and accountability that let the company run smoothly, without the founders being involved in every daily decision.



If you need someone to tell you what to do every day, this isn't the right fit. If you thrive with clear objectives and the autonomy to build real systems - and you're just as comfortable doing the daily operational grind as you are building the systems - keep reading.



What You'll Do:

-Set up ClickUp from scratch across all departments: workflows, dashboards, automations, task structures

-Make sure all work is captured in the system - nothing managed informally or lost in chat

-Be the team's first point of contact for day-to-day questions and blockers - not the founders

-Chase deadlines directly with tea
mbers and follow up when tasks haven't been updated

-Coordinate between Creative and Operations teams so projects move smoothly, resolving small cross-department friction points without escalating

-Document existing business processes into clear, usable SOPs

-Handle day-to-day approvals within defined boundaries, escalating only real issues to the founders

-Lead weekly/monthly KPI reviews and quarterly planning sessions

-Run the weekly tea
eting - status updates, blockers, decisions - focused and on time

-Translate founders' quarterly objectives into clear team and individual goals

-Monitor performance, spot problems early, and drive corrective action

-Track and report operational KPIs and cost trends, flagging profitability signals for the founders' review

-Build and manage the product-launch workflow based on the existing 15-step launch process

-Spot what's slowing the team down and fix it - don't just flag it

-Onboard new hires: set up tools, assign SOPs, guide their first weeks



Where the Founders Stay Involved

To be clear about where this role starts and stops: the Founders will continue to own overall company direction and priorities; brand, product, and market strategy; final decisions on launches, positioning, and pricing; approval of budgets, salaries, hiring/firing, and major investments; and review of high-level KPIs and reports.



This role owns everything else: the daily execution, systems, and team accountability that make those strategic decisions possible - including the follow-up, reminders, and day-to-day problem-solving that used to fall on the founders.



Tools You Must Know:

-ClickUp - expert level, you've built systems from scratch before

-Google Sheets / Excel - KPI dashboards, reporting

-Slack or similar - team communication

-Amazon Seller Central - you don't need to be a specialist, but you need to understand the context

-Zoom - weekly meetings with owner and team



Who We're Looking For:

We're looking for someone who's been in the trenches of ecommerce operations - not someone who's managed tasks, but someone who's built systems and led people.



-3+ years in operations or team management in an ecommerce or Amazon environment

-You've built SOPs from scratch and know how to make processes that people actually follow

-You've set up ClickUp or similar tools for a team starting from zero

-You know how to keep a remote team aligned and accountable - without being on their back every hour

-You're comfortable with numbers - KPIs, margins, performance tracking

-You're energized by the operational grind, not just the systems and dashboards, because that's most of what this role actually is day to day

-Excellent English, written and verbal

-Familiarity with Amazon tools

-You're looking for somewhere to grow long-term, not just another contract



Compensation & Setup:

-$1,800-$2,000/month based on experience

-Full-time, 40h/week

-14 days paid leave after 3 months

-First 3 months: time-tracked via Time Doctor as part of our standard onboarding process

-Long-term position - We Invest in People Who Invest in Us



What Success Looks Like

-Within 1 month: ClickUp is fully adopted, the weekly rhythm is running, and the founders' approval load has dropped significantly

-Within 3 months: KPIs are tracked and reviewed consistently; the team works to clear quarterly goals

-Within 6 months: the company runs smoothly day-to-day without the founders being involved in every decision



To Apply - Required

Answer these 4 questions. 



1. Describe a project management system you built from scratch (ClickUp, Asana, Monday, or similar) - what was the situation, how did you structure it, and what changed after? Only apply if you have actually done this. Do not describe what you would do - describe what you did.

2. How do you hold a remote team accountable without micromanaging? Give a real example from one of the companies listed in your CV: include the team size, what tool you used, and what happened when someone missed a deadline. Do not describe what you would do - describe what you actually did.

3. Walk me through a company from your CV where you managed people — how many reported directly to you, what were their roles, and what did your  one-on-ones or check-ins with them actually look like? What's one decision about a tea
mber (raise, warning, letting someone go, promotion) that was yours to make?

4. What project management tools have you used, and rate your confidence in each from 1 to 10. For the tool you rated highest - what's one thing you can do in it that most people don't know about?





Please also include your salary expectation and availability.

Location: Philippines — Remote

Type: Full-time

Experience: Minimum 1 year in Google Ads or paid media



About AdCeptive Media/

AdCeptive Media is a Dubai-based performance marketing company. We run paid campaigns for global eCommerce and lead generation clients — real budgets, real CPA targets, real accountability. We hire slowly, pay fairly, and give people who execute ownership of their work.



The Role:-

We need a Google Ads Media Buyer who can take a campaign brief and run with it. You will launch, manage, and optimize Search, Display, and Call-Only campaigns for lead generation clients. You will work under direct supervision following our campaign SOPs. You are not expected to independently own a new vertical from day one. You are expected to follow a framework, hit KPI targets, and flag problems before they become expensive.

If you need hand-holding on every decision, are comfortable with vague campaign briefs, or cannot explain why a CPA spiked — this role is not for you.



What You Will Do:-



• Launch and manage Google Ads campaigns across Search, Display, and Call-Only with proper structure and conversion tracking from day one

• Hit CPL and CPA targets — not just manage campaigns, but optimize them down

• Conduct keyword research, write ad copy variants, and run A/B tests on creatives, bids, and landing page hypotheses

• Set up and verify conversion tracking via Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics, and CAPI before any campaign goes live

• Submit weekly performance reports with diagnosis and next actions — not just numbers

• Identify scaling opportunities on accounts hitting targets and flag deterioration on those that aren't

• Collaborate with landing page and creative teams to improve funnel conversion rates

• Join client calls and internal reviews; communicate professionally across time zones





Must-Have Skills:-



• Minimum 1 year managing Google Ads campaigns (lead generation experience preferred)

• Solid understanding of Search campaign structure: match types, bid strategies, Quality Score, ad groups, negative keywords

• Can explain CPL, CPA, ROAS, CTR, and CPC fro
mory — and knows which metric matters most for which campaign type

• Hands-on experience with Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics for conversion setup

• Has run A/B tests and can explain what was tested, what happened, and why

• Strong written and spoken English

• Can work independently in a remote, async environment across time zones

• YouTube Ads experience

• Pay-per-call campaign exposure

• Experience with call tracking tools (CallRail, WhatConverts, Redtrack,Ringba etc.)

• Basic understanding of landing page optimization and funnel structure





What We Expect in Your First 90 Days:-

Day 1: Complete tool access setup, review one campaign and submit written observations to your manager by end of day, read and sign off on our Google Ads SOP.

First 30 days: Launch at least one campaign with full conversion tracking. Deliver weekly reports with specific optimizations taken. Bring one existing campaign's CPL down by a measurable amount — or write a clear diagnosis of what's blocking it.

First 90 days: Fully own your assigned accounts with minimal check-ins. Hit or beat target CPL/CPA on at least two accounts. Submit one scaling proposal for a high-performing account. Build a testing framework for at least one account.



Our Hiring Process:-

We run a structured process. Missing any requirement at any stage is an automatic rejection — not to be harsh, but because following instructions is the core skill this role demands.

2. Structured survey — technical skills, work ethic, self-management (40–45 min, no AI tools)

4. Culture interview — 45 min with the Hiring Lead, including a live walkthrough of your trial

5. Founder interview — 30 min, final call and offer discussion

The trial is paid. It takes 4–8 hours of real work. You will receive a simplified version of our Google Ads SOP before you start and your plan must follow it.



HOW TO APPLY:-



 your application to: 

Subject line — exact format, no variation: First Name-Last Name-Google Ads Media Buyer-Philippines (Example: Maria-Santos-Google Ads Media Buyer-Philippines)

 must include all of the following — missing any single item = no reply:-

2. Google Ads portfolio link or samples (live accounts, case studies, or anonymized screenshots with results)

 body: describe the single best result you have produced in a Google Ads campaign and exactly how you produced it

title: Influencer Marketing Specialist
description:
Influencer Marketing Specialist

(Growth path to UGC Lead/Influencer Marketing Manager)



Company: Ancient Remedies (Bublishing)

Department: Marketing – Creative Operations

Reports to: Performance Creative & Growth Operations Lead

Location: Remote (PH-based preferred; open to APAC time zones)

Employment type: Full-time



About the Role



Ancient Remedies is scaling influencer marketing — UGC, paid creator partnerships, affiliate/ambassador relationships, and PR seeding — as a core pillar of our paid social and organic growth engine. We're hiring an Influencer Marketing Specialist to own the day-to-day across all of it: creator sourcing, briefing, partnership management, and content pipeline — with a clear, defined path to owning the full influencer/UGC strategy as the function matures.



This is a builder's seat, not a maintenance seat. You'll start executing inside an existing creative system (angle library, hook vault, persona types) and grow into shaping how that system scales.



What You'll Own — Phase 1 (Specialist)



Influencer & Partnership Management

• Identify, vet, and build relationships with influencers (micro/mid-tier) whose audience fits our health & wellness positioning — beyond paid UGC creators.

• Run gifting/PR seeding campaigns to generate organic reach and unboxing/review content.

• Manage affiliate and ambassador relationships — commission structures, unique codes/links, ongoing partnership terms.

• Vet influencers for brand safety and audience quality before partnering.

• Track influencer-driven attribution (promo codes, UTM links, ROAS by partner) and report on what's actually driving sales vs. just reach.

• Ensure sponsored/influencer content follows FTC disclosure requirements and brand claims guidelines — this matters a lot for us as a health & wellness brand; coordinate with Creative Strategy on what can and can't be claimed.

• Stay current on platform trends/formats and bring that into creator briefs.

• Maintain an influencer CRM/tracking system for relationship history, rates, and performance.



UGC Pipeline & Systems

• Source, vet, and onboard creators/UGC talent across TikTok, Instagram, and creator marketplaces (Billo, Insense, TikTok Creator Marketplace, etc.).

• Manage the end-to-end creator pipeline: briefing, content collection, revisions, usage rights/contracts.

• Translate creative briefs (angles, hooks, personas) from the Creative Strategy team into clear, creator-ready direction.

• Track creator performance — output volume, turnaround time, and how their content actually performs as ads — and build a bench of repeat high-performers.

• Negotiate rates and manage the UGC budget within approved ranges.

• Organize and maintain the UGC content library so assets are tagged, searchable, and reusable.

• Set up and manage whitelisting/paid partnership ads (TikTok Spark Ads, Meta Partnership Ads) with the paid social team.

• Flag creative gaps back to Creative Strategy based on what's converting (new angles/personas needed).



What You'll Grow Into — Phase 2 (UGC Lead)

• Own the full influencer and UGC strategy end-to-end, not just execution.

• Build and manage a scaled creator/ambassador roster (retainers, exclusivity, ongoing relationships — not just one-offs).

• Own the affiliate/ambassador program strategy and expansion.

• Own UGC and influencer budget planning and forecasting

• Partner directly with Creative Strategy to define UGC-specific angle/hook testing plans.

• Potentially manage a coordinator/associate as volume grows.



Requirements

• 1.5–3+ years in influencer marketing, UGC/creator management, or a closely related performance creative role — DTC/e-commerce background strongly preferred.

• Proven track record sourcing and managing creators at volume (not just running one-off campaigns).

• Hands-on experience running influencer whitelisting/paid partnership ads (TikTok Spark Ads, Meta Partnership Ads, or similar).

• Familiarity with affiliate/ambassador program structures and attribution tracking (promo codes, UTMs, ROAS by partner).

• Comfortable reading ad performance data well enough to know what's working and why, not just what "feels good".

• Sharp communicator — can brief creators clearly and give feedback that actually improves output.

• Highly organized; can run a multi-creator pipeline without dropped threads.

• Working knowledge of UGC platforms/marketplaces, usage rights/contract terms, and FTC disclosure basics for sponsored content.



Nice to Have

• Existing creator/influencer relationships/network in health & wellness or DTC.

• Video editing background — can speak the language of hooks/pacing even without cutting themselves.

• Experience with influencer marketing platforms/CRMs (Grin, Aspire, Upfluence, or similar).

• Experience managing an affiliate program (Refersion, ShareASale, Impact, or similar).



What Success Looks Like

• 90 days: Creator pipeline running smoothly, consistent weekly UGC output, zero dropped threads.

• 6 months: Full ownership of the UGC calendar and creator roster; measurable lift in UGC-driven ad performance.

• 12 months: Ready to step into full UGC Lead ownership with a defined roster, system, and performance track record.

This is not a basic copywriting role.



We are looking for someone who can think beyond landing pages and
s. The right person will help engineer trust, authority, credibility, and revenue across every place a prospect, member, media outlet, pastor, partner, or strategic ally encounters the brand.



This role is closer to a Chief Narrative Officer than a traditional copywriter.



You will help shape how the movement is perceived, how the mission is explained, how prospects discover the brand through search, how high-ticket businessmen gain certainty, how media introduces the mission, how partners evaluate collaboration, and how members experience transformation.

High-Ticket Sales Assets

s, no-show sequences, follow-up sequences, win-back campaigns, reactivation campaigns, referral campaigns, upsell campaigns, and renewal campaigns.

SEO Authority Machine

Thought Leadership

You will help turn the movement into something people quote, reference, and follow through LinkedIn articles, Medium articles, guest articles, editorials, opinion pieces, open letters, predictions, industry reports, research summaries, white papers, position papers, Biblical theology papers, an Annual State of Christian Men report, and a State of Marriage report.

s, joint venture proposals, affiliate recruitment, podcast swap proposals, summit invitations, influencer collaboration pitches, referral agreements, and strategic alliance presentations.

This role is for a rare copywriter who does not simply write words.



We need someone who can become the architect of an organization’s narrative.



You should be able to understand the psychology of high-ticket buyers, the emotional world of Christian businessmen, the pain of marriage and leadership breakdown, and the desire for identity, order, authority, brotherhood, and transformation.



You should be able to write copy that builds trust, creates conviction, increases authority, drives qualified applications, supports sales, strengthens retention, and turns members into advocates.

- High-ticket funnel copy

- Brand messaging and positioning

- Sales psychology

- Long-form content

- SEO content strategy

- Thought leadership writing

-
 marketing

- VSLs, sales pages, and webinar copy

- Objection handling

- Customer avatar research

- Storytelling and narrative development

- Men’s leadership brands

- Business owners, entrepreneurs, CEOs, investors, doctors, brokers, board members, or high-income professionals

title: Construction Customer Service & Scheduling Coordinator
description:
Are you organized, personable, and great at juggling multiple priorities? We're looking for a Customer Service & Scheduling Coordinator to join our team, managing customer service calls and scheduling for our solar construction company across California.



This is a remote, full-time position aligned with the Pacific Time Zone (U.S.), working closely with our service technicians, project managers, and customers directly.



Responsibilities:

You will be the main point of contact for customers needing service support, including:

1. Answering and managing incoming service calls,
s, and inquiries from customers.

2. Scheduling and coordinating service appointments with field technicians based on availability and job priority.

3. Maintaining an organized service calendar and following up on rescheduling, delays, or cancellations.

4. Logging service requests, customer notes, and job details accurately in internal systems (Google Sheets, Zoho, or similar).

5. Communicating appointment confirmations, reminders, and updates to customers.

6. Coordinating with technicians to relay job details, special instructions, or customer concerns.

7. Following up with customers after completed service calls to confirm satisfaction and close out job records.

8. Assisting with basic administrative tasks such as filing, document organization, and report preparation.

9. Escalating urgent or unresolved issues to the appropriate team member promptly.



Qualifications:

1. Previous experience in customer service, scheduling, dispatch, or office administration is highly preferred.

2. Strong verbal and written English communication skills, with a friendly, professional phone manner.

3. Highly organized with strong attention to detail and follow-through.

4. Comfortable using Google Workspace (Sheets, Drive, Docs) or similar scheduling/CRM tools.

5. Able to multitask and stay calm under pressure when handling multiple calls or scheduling conflicts.

6. Proactive problem-solver who can work independently with minimal supervision.

7. Able to work flexible hours and thrive in a fast-paced, customer-facing environment.



What We Offer:

1. Competitive pay in USD (based on experience)

2. Long-term, stable, full-time role with growth potential

3. Work-from-home setup with performance-based incentives

4. Training on our service processes, tools, and customer systems

5. Opportunity to be part of a mission-driven U.S. clean energy company



Send your updated resume and a brief cover letter describing your relevant experience and why you'd be a great fit for this role. Include "dispatch" in your subject line.

• Creating a professional 6" × 9" Amazon KDP master template

Prepare detailed handover notes for the ongoing client service team.

Contribute to the continuous improvement of onboarding processes and best practices.

Build strong client relationships and create an outstanding first impression of Solve Outsource.



Skills & Experience



Essential Requirements



Must be a  CPA

Strong understanding of bookkeeping, management accounting, and financial controls.

Experience using accounting software such as Xero, QuickBooks, and/or Sage.

Excellent reconciliation and analytical problem-solving skills.

High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.

Strong organizational and time management abilities.

Ability to manage multiple onboarding projects simultaneously.

Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and take ownership of tasks.



What Makes This Role Different?



This is not a traditional bookkeeping or accounting position.

One week you could be onboarding a hospitality business, the next a construction company, wholesale distributor, golf club, or professional services firm.

Enjoys variety rather than repetitive processing work.

Loves solving problems and untangling accounting issues.

Takes pride in delivering accurate and complete financial records.

Enjoys learning new technologies and accounting systems.

Wants exposure to a wide range of industries and business models.

Thrives in a fast-paced, growing organization.



Why Join Solve Outsource?

Work with a growing and ambitious outsourced finance business.

Gain exposure to diverse industries and accounting systems.

Develop both technical accounting and client-facing skills.

Join a supportive, collaborative, and high-performing team.

Enjoy genuine career progression opportunities as the company grows.

Make a meaningful impact on client success from day one.

title: HR Co-ordinator & Operations Support
description:
HR Co-ordinator & Operations Support — Part Time (25 hrs) with Path to Full Time



DESIRED NO. OF HOURS PER WEEK - 25



About Us

We're an Australian dog walking and pet sitting company 
. Our growth depends on two things: finding great walkers and sitters, and making sure every run is scheduled and covered. 



This is a hybrid role, roughly two-thirds recruitment and HR, one-third operations support. If you like variety and don't want to do the same task all day, you'll enjoy it.



Part 1 — Recruitment & HR (your main focus)

Sourcing & Job Ads



- Write, post and refresh job ads across job boards and community platforms

- Manage our
 presence for recruitment — posting in relevant local groups, responding to comments and DMs, and -keeping a schedule of where and when we post

- Actively source candidates rather than waiting for applications to arrive

- Keep a healthy, consistent pipeline so we're never scrambling to cover a suburb



Screening & Interviews



- Review applications and screen candidates against our criteria

- Arrange and schedule interviews across Australian time zones for our operations manage

- Follow up with candidates



Onboarding & Compliance



- Guide new walkers and sitters through onboarding compliance end to end

- Prepare, send and track all required documents and agreements

- Chase outstanding paperwork until it's complete 

- Maintain accurate, organised records for every tea
mber



Part 2 — Operations Support



You'll work directly alongside our Operations Manager to make sure every daily run across Sydney goes out smoothly.

We use software that handles the heavy lifting of routing and dispatch — you don't need prior experience with this, and we'll teach you. What you will learn is how our runs are actually built: efficient and safe routes, sensible pick-up windows, which parks suit which dogs, and how to sequence a day so our walkers aren't stretched and the dogs in our care are looked after properly.

Day to day, that means:



- Supporting the Operations Manager to build and finalise the daily runs for our team of walkers across Sydney

- Maintaining the data our scheduling software relies on — clean, accurate, and up to date. Good routes come from good data, and this is where you make or break the day

- Checking runs before they go out and catching problems early

- Helping resolve day-of changes — cancellations, sick walkers, reschedules — so nothing falls through

- Communicating clearly with walkers about their schedules

- Flagging coverage gaps back into recruitment, so we hire ahead of demand rather than behind it



What We're Looking For



- Excellent written English — you'll be representing our brand publicly in
 groups and messaging our team every day

- Comfortable with
 Groups, job boards, CRM's, Google Workspace, and spreadsheets

- Genuinely organised. You don't need reminders to follow up

- Self-directed. We want someone who owns their patch, not someone waiting to be told what to do next

- Reliable overlap with Australian business hours (AEST)



Nice to Have



- Experience with scheduling, dispatch, logistics or route-planning software (helpful, not required)

- Experience recruiting for gig, hospitality, or field-based roles

- Familiarity with ATS or CRM tools

- You LOVE dogs ????





The Details



Starting at 25 hours per week

Genuine path to full time (40 hrs/week) for the right candidate — this isn't a vague carrot. As our team grows, so does the recruitment and coordination workload, and we want the person doing it well to grow with it

Long-term and stable — we're looking for someone to stay, not a short contract

Direct working relationship with the owner — no layers of management

Real autonomy over how recruitment runs

Room to grow into a broader HR/Operations role as we scale



How to Apply

Start your application with the word "FETCH" so we know you read this properly.

Then tell us:



A recruitment or onboarding process you've run — what you were responsible for, and what the result was

A time you had to fix a scheduling problem at short notice. What happened and what did you do?

How you'd approach finding dog walkers in a city you've never been to

Your available hours, your overlap with AEST, and whether you'd be interested in moving to full time down the track

Producing 3 hooks per video

Turning our raw ideas + strategy into scroll-stopping creatives

Using AI tools like ElevenLabs and AI Personas where it makes sense

Iterating based on performance data

Working directly with me — fast feedback, fast decisions

Helping push the brand from “doing well” to dominating

Candidates with this skill set will have a strong advantage.

You’ve edited direct-response ads for e-commerce brands

You understand performance, not just visuals

You have a STRONG EYE for details

You’re fast, disciplined, and competitive

You care about results and high standards

You want to work exclusively on one brand and help grow it

If you want something slow, safe, and corporate — this isn’t for you.



Compensation:

Full-time, remote role

Base salary depends on experience and skill

Performance-based bonuses tied directly to ad results

For strong performers, monthly bonuses can realistically reach around $1,000, depending on output and performance. There’s no fixed cap — results drive upside. If you make winning ads, you make more money. When the brand wins, you win.

This starts as a Video Editor role, but there’s room to grow. If you consistently deliver, understand what’s working, and show good judgment over time, you can move into a better role with more responsibility and higher pay. I’m building brands for the long run and looking for people who want stability, ownership, and multi-year collaboration, not constant job hopping.

To filter unserious applicants, start your message with:

“I create high-converting creatives.”

Then include:

Your experience with video editing & direct response ads

Whether you have AI experience

Links to relevant e-commerce ad work (portfolio)

Your availability and start date

Why you want to work with us



If this resonates and you’d thrive in this environment, D
 and I’ll get back to you.

Speak soon, Karos

title: Part-Time Project Coordinator / Proactive Virtual Assistant
description:
BUILD WITH JOY — please begin your application with these words.



PART-TIME PROJECT COORDINATOR / PROACTIVE VIRTUAL ASSISTANT

Live co-working and creative web projects

20 hours per week · $15/hour · $300/week · 30-day paid trial at the same rate



This role has room to grow over time. I hope to find someone I enjoy working with for years rather than months.



ABOUT THE ROLE

I run several long-term web and community projects. I'm looking for someone who enjoys helping turn ideas into finished work.



My main need is not someone who waits for a complete task list. I need someone who can listen to an idea, ask useful questions, help determine what matters most, propose a practical plan, and take ownership of agreed work.



I value kindness, curiosity, honesty, and good judgment more than speed.



This is a professional project role with an unusual co-working structure.



HOW THE WEEK WILL WORK

The role is 20 hours per week across four days:

- Three days: five-hour live video co-working sessions with me

- One day: five hours of independent work



During the three co-working days, we will remain connected in a video room for most of the five-hour session, aside from normal breaks. We will usually have cameras on, but we will not talk constantly or hold a five-hour meeting. We will often work quietly alongside each other, with periodic conversations and check-ins.



On the independent day, you will move agreed work forward without waiting for me to direct every action.



The exact days and times are negotiable, but you must be able to maintain a consistent five-hour overlap with Portland, Oregon, on three weekdays.



CURRENT PROJECTS


 — an online music-related project. Work may include testing the website, organizing bugs and feedback, coordinating with users or testers, tracking unresolved decisions, recommending priorities, and helping move the project toward a clear milestone.




 — an established online drawing website. I want to explore ways to strengthen its pages, community, communication, and user experience. Work may include research, collecting and organizing user feedback, drafting page structures and copy, developing small community experiments, creating simple layouts or mockups, using AI tools to assist with writing and ideation, and helping determine which ideas are worth testing.



Community Projects — meetup and community concepts intended to create connection, creativity, delight, and positive experiences. These may eventually involve event planning, outreach, participant communication, contributor coordination, and simple organizational systems.



We will not try to work on every project simultaneously. An important part of this role is helping narrow the active priorities.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Help turn broad or incomplete ideas into concrete plans

- Recommend what should happen next

- Help us select one active priority and protect our focus from unnecessary switching

- Maintain a simple and reliable project board

- Keep priorities, decisions, and follow-ups organized

- Take ownership of clearly agreed project areas

- Coordinate feedback, testing, outreach, or contributors

- Draft copy, research, outlines, and simple visual materials

- Use AI tools thoughtfully to accelerate work

- Notice when work is becoming unfocused and help narrow it

- Finish each session with a useful progress summary



I appreciate thoughtful disagreement. If you think I'm wrong, I want to hear why.



WHO WILL FIT THIS ROLE

You may be a project coordinator, virtual assistant, community manager, startup generalist, or operations assistant.



The strongest candidate will be highly proficient in written and conversational English, comfortable communicating naturally on video, friendly and thoughtful, self-motivated, able to work without constant supervision, comfortable with projects that are not fully defined at the start, organized and consistent, comfortable using ChatGPT and learning new tools, and equipped with reliable internet for extended video calls.



You do not need to be a programmer or an expert designer. Initiative, judgment, communication, and follow-through matter more than a perfect list of technical skills.



COMPENSATION AND TRIAL

$15/hour · 20 hours/week · $300/week



The position will begin with a 30-day paid trial at the same rate, with the possibility of continuing as a stable, long-term role when the fit is strong.



FIRST 30 DAYS

During the initial trial, success will mean establishing a dependable co-working rhythm, creating one simple shared system for tracking our active projects, selecting a primary project, moving it toward one visible milestone, and identifying at least one area you can manage independently.



HOW TO APPLY

Please keep your application concise and begin with the words:

BUILD WITH JOY



Then include:

1. A short introduction.

2. A link to a casual video of approximately two minutes. Professional editing is not needed. Please make sure the link can be viewed without requesting access. In the video: say your name, briefly introduce yourself, explain why this working structure interests you, and describe one project you moved forward without receiving step-by-step instructions.

3. List the five-hour weekday work windows you could consistently provide. You do not need to be available every weekday; I want to understand which three recurring co-working days could work. Show each work window in Portland, Oregon local time and Philippine Time. Also state your current weekly work commitments and the earliest date you could begin.

4. Describe one previous situation in which you received an unclear goal and turned it into concrete work. What did you do first, and what was the result?

5. Imagine I tell you: "Sketchpad is an established drawing website. I think it needs a stronger community, but I do not yet know what that should mean." What are the first three actions you would recommend, and why?

6. Briefly describe your normal internet connection, whether it reliably supports extended video calls, and what backup option you have if your internet or electricity becomes unavailable.



You may use AI tools, but specific examples and your own reasoning matter more than polished wording. Please do not send a generic cover letter.



HIRING PROCESS

1. Written application and short video

2. Video interview

3. Paid working session with selected finalists

4. Thirty-day paid trial



Thank you for reading the complete posting.

title: SEO Content Writer
description:
We are building a premium direct-to-consumer (DTC) ecommerce brand in the women's wellness industry, with an initial focus on the European market.



Our mission is to become a trusted educational resource while offering high-quality products that help women navigate the challenges of perimenopause and menopause.



Content will play a central role in our growth strategy. We are not looking for someone who simply writes articles—we are looking for someone who can help us build authority, trust, and long-term organic traffic through exceptional SEO content.



This is a long-term freelance opportunity for the right candidate.



The Role



We are looking for an experienced SEO Content Writer who understands both search engine optimization and high-quality editorial writing.



Your primary objective will be to create educational, evidence-informed, SEO-optimized content that genuinely helps readers while supporting our long-term organic growth strategy.



You should be capable of writing content that ranks well on Google without sacrificing readability or user experience.



Responsibilities



You will be responsible for:



SEO Research

Perform keyword research.

Identify high-intent and long-tail keyword opportunities.

Analyze search intent.

Suggest content clusters and pillar pages.

Research competitor content.

Identify internal linking opportunities.

Content Writing



Create comprehensive articles covering topics such as:



Perimenopause

Menopause

Brain fog

Sleep

Fatigue

Mood changes

Hot flashes

Nutrition

Gut health

Hormonal wellbeing

Stress management

Exercise

Productivity at work

Lifestyle habits

Women's health



Each article should:



Answer the reader's questions clearly.

Provide genuine value.

Be engaging and easy to read.

Follow SEO best practices.

Be evidence-informed.

Respect health content standards.

Naturally guide readers toward our products when appropriate (without sounding like a sales pitch).

SEO Optimization



Each article should include:



SEO-friendly title

Meta title

Meta description

Proper heading structure (H1, H2, H3)

Internal linking suggestions

Suggested external authoritative references

FAQ section (where appropriate)

Suggested featured image ideas

Suggested call-to-action

Brand Voice



The tone should be:



Warm

Empathetic

Professional

Trustworthy

Science-informed

Easy to understand

Encouraging

Modern

Premium



Our readers should feel understood, supported, and educated.



Content Quality Standards



Because we operate in the health and wellness sector, every article should demonstrate strong E-E-A-T principles:



Experience

Expertise

Authoritativeness

Trustworthiness



Accuracy is extremely important.



Content should educate readers responsibly and avoid unsupported or misleading health claims.



Preferred Experience



Experience writing in one or more of the following industries is highly preferred:



Women's health

Menopause

Nutrition

Supplements

Functional medicine

Healthcare

Wellness

Beauty

Fitness

DTC Ecommerce



Experience writing for Shopify brands is a strong advantage.



Desired Skills



You should have experience with:



SEO writing

Search intent optimization

Keyword clustering

On-page SEO

Internal linking

E-E-A-T content

AI-assisted research workflows (while producing original, high-quality writing)



Experience using tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, Surfer SEO, Frase, Clearscope, Google Search Console, or similar platforms is appreciated.



Deliverables



Initially, we expect approximately:



4 high-quality SEO articles per month

Approximately 1,500–2,500+ words per article

Keyword research

Meta title

Meta description

Internal linking suggestions

CTA recommendations



As the business grows, this workload may increase.



How Success Will Be Measured



Success is not measured by the number of words written.



Instead, we are looking for content that contributes to:



Increased organic traffic

Better keyword rankings

Higher engagement

Longer reading time

Increased
 sign-ups

More product page visits

Greater brand authority

Higher trust with our audience

Who We're Looking For



We're looking for someone who:



Enjoys researching complex health topics.

Can simplify scientific information for everyday readers.

Writes naturally for people first and search engines second.

Thinks strategically about content.

Is reliable and detail-oriented.

Delivers consistently high-quality work.

Wants to become a long-term partner rather than complete one-off assignments.

Application Requirements



To apply, please include:



A short introduction about yourself.

Your experience writing SEO content.

Links to 3–5 published articles (preferably in health, wellness, nutrition, supplements, beauty, or ecommerce).

If possible, briefly describe any measurable SEO results your content has achieved (for example, keyword rankings, organic traffic growth, featured snippets, or increased conversions).

The SEO tools you regularly use.

Your preferred pricing (hourly and/or per article).

Whether you have experience writing for Shopify or DTC ecommerce brands.

Your typical content creation process—from keyword research to final delivery.



Applications without writing samples will not be considered.



Selection Process



We believe that a strong portfolio and practical skills are far more valuable than simply listing SEO knowledge on a CV.



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a paid writing test.



Paid Writing Test



The test assignment will include:



Keyword research for one topic

Search intent analysis

A detailed article outline

One SEO-optimized article (approximately 1,500–2,000 words)

Meta title

Meta description

Suggested internal links

Suggested external references

FAQ section

Suggested call-to-action



The writing test is paid, as we respect the time and expertise of professional freelancers.



Long-Term Opportunity



Our objective is to build a long-term relationship with a talented SEO content writer who can grow alongside our brand.



If you enjoy creating content that genuinely helps people, understand how to write authoritative SEO articles, and are excited about contributing to the growth of a premium ecommerce brand, we would love to hear from you.

title: Amazon Account / Brand Operations Manager (Private Label)
description:
Are you a strategic, data-driven Amazon operator with a passion for optimization and brand growth?

We are a fast-growing Amazon private label brand seeking a full-time Amazon Account / Brand Operations Manager to oversee our listing performance, conversion optimization, and brand presence on Amazon.



You’ll play a key leadership role in improving conversion rates, maintaining a strong brand identity, and driving account health through data-backed decisions. This is a long-term opportunity with growth potential in a collaborative, performance-driven environment.



Key Responsibilities

Accountability & Ownership

Own and optimize Amazon listings for maximum visibility and conversions

Manage brand positioning, messaging, and consistency across listings, A+ content, and storefront

Implement CRO strategies and coordinate ongoing A/B tests

Coordinate freelancers and vendors (designers, photographers, copywriters, content creators)

Monitor and improve brand health metrics: rankings, reviews, CTR, CR, Buy Box, etc.

Ensure Amazon account hygiene: compliance, suppressed listings, variations, flat files (as needed), category attributes, and policy adherence



Daily & Weekly Tasks

Perform ongoing listing audits and implement improvements (titles, bullets, images, backend, A+, attributes)

Analyze competitors for positioning and conversion opportunities (without product scouting)

Track performance: sessions, conversion rate, CTR, sales rank, review velocity, return rate

Collaborate with PPC, supply chain, and creative teams to align:

Listing updates with ad strategy

Inventory levels with promo and demand forecasts

Creative needs with conversion goals

Manage reporting and ensure action items are executed consistently



Long-Term Projects & Goals

Build a consistent, strategic brand identity across all customer touchpoints on Amazon

Create a repeatable system for ongoing listing improvement and CRO

Improve customer loyalty and retention through stronger messaging, brand voice, and content

Develop SOPs for listing updates, creative briefs, review management, and performance reporting



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

KPI 1: Listing Quality & Organic Performance

Objective: Improve listing visibility and discoverability through optimization



Metrics:

Keyword indexing coverage + organic rank improvements

CTR improvements (Search + ads-supported)

Reduction in suppressed/invalid attributes and listing issues

Actions:

Run keyword research and update listings using Helium 10 + market analysis

Maintain listing audit checklist and optimization tracker

Monitor indexing, rank trends, and category attribute completeness



KPI 2: Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)

Objective: Improve conversion rate through data-backed iteration

Metric: Conversion Rate (%) from Amazon Business Reports

Actions:

Optimize copy, images, A+ content, and brand story

Run split tests where possible (ManageByStats, Splitly, Experiments, or equivalent)

Monitor behavior signals (CTR, CVR, returns, reviews) and iterate



KPI 3: Brand Health & Customer Trust

Objective: Improve brand reputation and customer experience

Metrics:

Review rating + review velocity

Return rate trends and top return reasons

Q&A hygiene and listing clarity improvements

Actions:

Review monitoring + recurring issue reporting

Coordinate content updates to address objections/returns

Strengthen product education via visuals + A+ modules

Qualifications & Skills



Required

3+ years managing private label brands on Amazon (account management / listing optimization

Deep understanding of Amazon SEO and algorithm fundamentals

Strong experience with Helium 10, keyword research, and listing optimization

Proven ability to brief and coordinate creatives (designers, copywriters, photographers)

Familiarity with A+ content, storefront management, and conversion tracking

Strong operational discipline: can manage tasks, trackers, and deadlines without hand-holding



Preferred

Background in marketing, branding, or e-commerce growth strategy

Experience with CRO/testing platforms (e.g., ManageByStats, Splitly, Amazon Experiments)

Experience using Asana, Notion, or Trello for project management

Understanding of PPC’s relationship to CTR/CVR and organic rank (coordination-level, not necessarily hands-on media buying)



Soft Skills

Ownership mentality and high attention to detail

Strong marketing instincts and customer-centric thinking

Excellent written and verbal English communication

Organized, proactive, and reliable

Analytical mindset — able to turn data into decisions



What We Offer

Competitive rates

Fully remote

Bi-weekly payments and performance reviews

Long-term role with growth potential

Paid leave and additional benefits after 6 months (SSS, Pag-ibig, health insurance)

Supportive team culture with room for innovation and contribution

Training resources and personal development opportunities



How to Apply

Include in subject line: “[Your Favorite Book] - Amazon Account / Brand Manager Application”

Attach your updated resume

Include a short video (2–3 min) introducing yourself and describing your:

Experience optimizing Amazon listings and improving conversion rates

Tools you’ve used and how you used them

A specific listing improvement you made and the result (CTR/CVR/rank/reviews)

Complete the internet speed test from speedtest.net and attach a screenshot

Attach a screenshot with your computer specs



Why Join Us?

This is more than just account management. It’s an opportunity to take ownership of Amazon performance, strengthen a real brand, and build systems that scale. If you’re driven by impact, autonomy, and measurable outcomes, we’d love to meet you.
