title: Creative Designer
description:
Creative Designer

US-Based MSP | 100% Remote | Full-Time

Great design is still a human skill. The best creatives today just have better tools — and know exactly when to use them.



To apply please fill out the application form here: 
/bepartofourteam.



About the Company

We're a family-owned business with all-local Philippines leadership and team. We've been 100% work-from-home since day one — not a pandemic pivot. We've grown by valuing our people, building long-term relationships, and doing great work for great clients.



The Role

We're looking for a Creative Designer who understands that AI doesn't make great design — designers do. But the right tools, used well, make great designers faster, more prolific, and more creative than they'd be without them.

You'll own full creative production across marketing, brand, and content — static, motion, and video. You'll use AI where it genuinely helps: ideation, exploration, iteration, and production acceleration. And you'll apply your own judgment, taste, and craft to make sure the final output is something a machine could never produce on its own.



The Mindset We're Looking For

The best creative professionals we've worked with share a few traits:



They know that AI makes a great starting point, not a finished product. They use it to explore ideas faster, break through creative blocks, and accelerate production — then they take it the rest of the way themselves

They have strong creative instincts that no tool can replicate. They know when something is off, when something isn't good enough, and what it would take to make it right

They take ownership of quality. They don't ship work they're not proud of — regardless of how it was made

They're curious about new tools and genuinely open to learning them — not because someone told them to, but because staying sharp matters to them

They communicate clearly about creative decisions. They can explain why something works, take feedback without getting defensive, and push back when a direction isn't right





Who Thrives Here

People who are serious about the craft and smart about the tools. You believe a human designer will always make the work better — and you prove it in everything you ship. You're not resistant to AI, but you're not dependent on it either. You know the difference.

We're a growing MSP with expanding creative needs across marketing, brand, and content. For the right person, that's the opportunity to shape a creative function that produces exceptional work — not just efficient work.



What You'll Do

You'll walk into a business with real creative output needs across marketing, brand, and content — and the expectation that everything that ships is something you're proud to put your name on.

That looks like:



Producing the full range of marketing and brand creative — social graphics, digital ads,
 campaigns, presentations, and promotional materials — at a high standard, on time, every time

Using AI tools for ideation, concept exploration, and production support — then applying your own judgment and craft to take the output where it needs to go

Creating motion graphics, short-form video, and reels that drive real engagement — not just content that fills a calendar

Generating and refining AI imagery and integrating it into polished, on-brand work where it makes the piece stronger, not just faster

Maintaining brand consistency across every output — and flagging when guidelines need to evolve, not just following them blindly

Building reusable templates, asset libraries, and brand components that make the creative process more consistent and scalable

Collaborating with marketing and leadership to translate campaign objectives into creative that performs — not just looks good

Staying current on both design craft and emerging tools — bringing the best of both into the work





What We're Looking For



A strong portfolio demonstrating range across static, motion, and video creative — this is the first and most important filter

Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects, Premiere Pro or equivalent) — your craft fundamentals are solid and don't depend on AI to cover gaps

Openness to and working familiarity with AI creative tools (image generation, AI video, AI-assisted workflows) — you've explored them, you use them selectively, and you understand their limits

Motion graphics and video production capability — concept, produce, and deliver independently

Strong understanding of marketing principles and branding — every design decision serves a purpose

Excellent conversational English — clear, natural, and easy to listen to; creative conversations and feedback feel easy, not formal

High attention to detail — you catch what's off before anyone else does

Self-directed — brief in, questions asked upfront, work delivered without hand-holding

Honest communicator — if a direction isn't working, you say so and come with a better idea



Nice to have:



Experience with AI video tools (Runway, Kling, Pika, or equivalent) used as part of a broader creative process

UI/UX or web design experience

Photography or videography skills

Experience in a marketing team or agency environment





How Onboarding Works (And How That Changes)

We're honest about how we work with new tea
mbers.

In your first weeks and months, you'll have real hands-on support from the team. We'll work closely with you to understand our brand, our clients, our standards, and how we operate. We expect questions — and we'll give you the time to learn.

As you show what you can do — that involvement steps back quickly. Trust grows fast here. People who demonstrate ownership and quality work earn autonomy quickly — and significant creative latitude to shape how the brand looks, feels, and moves.

We earn each other's trust through real work — then we get out of the way.



What Success Looks Like

At three months: You're producing on-brand creative consistently and on time across static and motion formats. The work is clearly yours — AI may have helped, but the quality is unmistakably human. You've identified gaps in the creative library and started filling them.

At six months: Marketing campaigns have stronger visual execution than before you joined. Motion and video content is a regular part of output. You've introduced tools or workflows that made the team faster without lowering the creative bar.

At twelve months: The brand looks and feels measurably more polished. You've built systems and asset libraries that scale beyond your own output.



How We Work

We trust our people to do great work and give them the space to do it. Meaningful work means making decisions — and sometimes those won't be right on the first try. We don't punish thoughtful mistakes. We learn and move forward.

We're a growing MSP — not every creative process is built yet. That's part of why we need someone who brings craft and structure to the work, not just waits for direction.



This Role Is Not for You If:



You rely on AI to do all the creative thinking for you

You ship work that's technically complete but not something you're proud of

You treat brand guidelines as optional

Feedback makes you defensive rather than curious

You're not interested in learning new tools or evolving how you work

You separate craft from process — great output requires both



There's no judgment in that list — it's just not the environment. We'd rather be honest now than waste each other's time.



What We Offer



Competitive salary based on experience

100% remote — no corporate commute, ever

Weekly pay via Wise direct deposit

Tech and internet allowance

Paid vacation leave

HMO

Access to the latest AI tools (Claude, Code, and more) to work smarter and automate more

Career growth

title: AI Automation Specialist (WhatsApp & Chat Automation)
description:
About the Role



We are hiring a solid AI Automation Specialist to own and maintain our AI-powered WhatsApp and chat automation system.



This role focuses on designing, maintaining, and optimising AI-assisted chat workflows that handle customer enquiries, bookings, and routing — replacing and supporting human customer service operations.



This is not a software engineering role and not AI research.

It is a logic-driven automation and operations role.



What You Will Do



You will be the primary owner of our AI chat automation.



Core Responsibilities



Design and maintain chat automation workflows



Configure AI responses, prompts, and guardrails



Build multi-step logic for enquiries, bookings, and routing



Handle intent detection and escalation to human agents



Test edge cases (unclear intent, wrong info, user changes mind)



Monitor live conversations and optimise performance



Maintain clear documentation of workflows and rules



You Will NOT



Write backend or frontend code



Train AI models



Build websites or mobile apps



Do machine learning or data science



Required Skills (Must-Have)



We are looking for someone solid and experienced, not entry-level.



You should have experience in some of the following:



WhatsApp or chat automation platforms



Chatbot or CRM automation workflows



Designing logic-based conversation flows



Prompt writing with clear rules and boundaries



Handling human handover and exception cases



Strong logical thinking and attention to detail



Good documentation habits



Nice to Have (Not Mandatory)



Experience with automation tools (Zapier, Make, etc.)



Basic understanding of webhooks or APIs



Experience supporting or replacing customer service teams



Operations or process-improvement background



What We Care About (Very Important)



We care more about thinking and reliability than buzzwords.



You should be able to explain:



What an AI chat should do when it is unsure



When automation should stop and escalate to a human



How to prevent wrong replies or wrong bookings



Salary & Work Arrangement



Salary: USD 800– 1,000 / month (based on experience)



Location: Philippines (remote, home-based)



Working hours: Aligned with Singapore time (GMT+8)



Employment: Full-time, long-term



Why This Role Is Different



You own the automation logic



Your work directly impacts operations and revenue



Stable, long-term role (not freelance or project-based)



Clear scope — no random tech tasks



Application Instructions (Mandatory)



To apply, please include:



A short description of your experience with chat or workflow automation



ONE example of a workflow you built

(describe the logic and decision flow, no screenshots needed)



Answer this question:

“What should an AI chat do when it does not fully understand the user’s intent?”



Applications that do not follow the above will not be considered.



Final Note (Filters the Right Candidates)



This role is not for beginners and not for programmers.

It is for someone who enjoys building reliable automation systems and thinking through real-world customer scenarios.

title: Animator For A 2D Animation Series

This is a team effort. I’m the creator and writer, and I’m looking for artists who want to help build something from the ground up.



The series includes graphic violence, blood, and mature themes, so applicants must be comfortable illustrating those types of scenes.



If we’re a good fit, my goal is to build a long-term working relationship with artists who grow alongside the series.



Compensation



Part-Time | Remote



Trial Period (First 90 Days)



* $250 USD/month

* 10–15 hours per week

* Flexible schedule

* Performance & milestone bonuses



After 90 Days



Successful artists may be promoted to:



* $600+/month

* Continued bonuses

* Long-term opportunities

* Increased responsibilities as the series grows



Requirements



Applicants must:

* Be 18+

* Draw digitally

* Have experience with 2D animation

* Understand anatomy, perspective and lighting

* Animate action and emotional scenes

* Maintain character consistency

* Understand storyboarding and cinematic composition

* Meet deadlines

* Communicate well

* Sign an NDA



Character Consistency

One of the most important parts of this project is consistency. Characters, clothing, tattoos, hairstyles, body proportions, accessories, and recurring environments must remain consistent throughout every episode.



Environment Consistency

Recurring locations and environments must remain visually consistent across episodes.



Bonus Skills

Experience with character design, storyboarding, effects animation, background painting, cinematic composition, or AI-assisted production workflows is a plus.



Paid Trial Assignment

Finalists will complete a paid test using provided character and environment references from Episode 1.



The assignment will consist of creating:



* A 10–15 second fully animated scene or

* A storyboard and one fully rendered key scene (depending on the applicant’s primary skill set).



The purpose of the assignment is to evaluate:



* Ability to follow direction

* Character consistency

* Animation quality

* Scene composition

* Communication

* Turnaround time



The trial is paid regardless of whether you are hired.



Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is someone who wants to grow with an original animated series—not someone looking for a one-time freelance project.



If you’re passionate about storytelling, anime, and long-term collaboration, I’d love to hear from you.



I’m looking for someone who wants to help build one of the next great independent animated series.

We specialize in resolving complex financial and compliance-related challenges across multiple jurisdictions, including banking, corporate structuring, and regulatory coordination.

Position Overview



As a Paralegal / Funds Release Specialist at Suits Finance, you will play a critical role in assisting clients whose company bank accounts or funds have been frozen, held, or restricted by financial institutions or payment service providers.



You will work closely with bank representatives, compliance teams, and internal stakeholders to prepare documentation, draft formal correspondence, and support account remediation and funds release processes. This role requires a strong understanding of banking procedures, compliance requirements, and legal documentation related to corporate accounts.





Key Responsibilities



Funds Release & Banking Compliance Support

- Handle cases involving frozen, held, or restricted corporate bank accounts and funds.

- Assist in preparing and organizing documentation required by banks and financial institutions for account remediation and fund release.

- Coordinate with bank compliance teams, payment processors, and third-party institutions to support resolution processes.

- Track case progress, deadlines, and compliance requirements across multiple jurisdictions (US, UK, EU, HK).



Legal & Paralegal Functions

- Draft formal letters, affidavits, declarations, and explanations required for banking compliance reviews.

- Review and organize corporate documents (Articles of Incorporation, Operating Agreements, Shareholder Registers, KYC documents, etc.).

- Support legal research related to banking regulations, compliance requirements, and account restrictions.

- Maintain accurate records of case files, correspondence, and supporting documents.



Client Communication & Case Management

- Communicate professionally with clients to gather information and explain required steps for fund release.

- Provide clear updates on case status, requirements, and next actions.

- Collaborate closely with internal teams to ensure cases are handled efficiently and accurately.





Qualifications & Requirements

- Proven experience as a Paralegal, Legal Assistant, or Banking Compliance Specialist.

- Strong familiarity with cases involving frozen or held corporate bank accounts and funds.

- Knowledge of banking compliance procedures, KYC/AML requirements, and corporate documentation.

- Experience working with banks, payment processors, or financial institutions is a strong advantage.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, especially for formal and client-facing correspondence.

- Highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple cases simultaneously.

- Experience with cross-border clients or international corporate structures is preferred.





Why Join Suits Finance?

- Be part of a globally connected and professional team.

- Gain hands-on exposure to complex banking compliance and funds release cases.

- Enjoy a 100% remote work setup with flexible hours and supportive management.

- Work on high-impact cases that directly help clients regain access to their funds.

- Be valued for your precision, legal insight, and problem-solving skills.





Application Process



Interested candidates are invited to submit their resume and a cover letter highlighting their paralegal, banking compliance, or funds release experience.

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Accounts Assistant

We’re on the lookout for an Accounts Assistant to join our expanding team.  



A Bit About HeadBox

At HeadBox, our purpose is simple. We connect people and spaces to make brilliant things happen.

But it's not always been straightforward to hire or host at an amazing venue. In fact, prior to the company's inception in 2015, it was the exact opposite. Our business was born from frustration at the outdated, slow, inefficient and time-consuming venue booking process that anyone looking to book a space had to endure.

Since then, we've uncovered more challenges faced by corporates, venue managers and people looking for venue space but our purpose has always remained the same. We've spent the last few years becoming obsessed with our customers and their problems so that we can build products, tools and features to make their lives easier. Think of it as human-kind event-tech. Our ecosystem of products make event and venue management simple, secure and transparent, whether you want to hire a space or host an event.

HeadBox Australia launched in 2020 led by Ali Lord, ex-Head of Events at Dentsu Aegis UK. In her previous role, Ali was one of the early adopters of the HeadBox Business technology and experienced first hand the benefits and efficiencies it provides corporations. Ali quickly knew this was a product she had to bring back to Australia.

HeadBox are now in the process of taking Australia by storm and are looking for a new tea
mber to join us on this exciting journey.



About You

You can hit the ground running, ideally holding a Bachelor’s degree in Accountancy or related professional qualification with at least 2 years of experience in a similar role with demonstrated skills and abilities.. 

You have hands-on experience and good understanding of using Xero accounting software. 

It would be advantageous for you to hold knowledge of the Australian taxation and accounting system. 

You’re highly organised, detail-oriented, and can work well under pressure. You have a strong work ethic, a curiosity for learning, and a desire to contribute to our collective success.



The Role

The Accounts Assistant is primarily responsible for Accounts Receivables, Accounts Payable and Bookkeeping functions across the business. Reporting to the Finance Officer, this role has a wealth of variety on offer as you’ll be exposed to all areas of the business as new customers join and the teams win new business. 



Key Responsibilities



- Accounts Receivable & Payable

- Prepare and issue invoices to HeadBox clients in consultation with the business development, customer success and event planning and event management tea
mbers. 

- Manage overdue invoices and follow up on outstanding payments.

- Reconcile bank transactions and accounts.

- Process and code supplier invoices accurately.

- Assist with month-end and year-end reconciliations.

- Support the preparation of accurate financial reports and schedules.

- Ensure compliance with accounting and financial reporting standards.



Miscellaneous Support

- Assist the finance and operations team with ad hoc tasks from time to time

- Support the commercial teams with finance-related queries and data.



Requirements 

- Commercial aspiration: a drive and willingness to learn the key commercial skills required to be a competent commercial tea
mber.

- Communication: it is important that you have strong interpersonal and communication skills as you will be interacting with clients and you will be required to tailor your communication appropriately to the right person. 

- Attention to detail: goes without saying really, but nothing goes unnoticed by you. You're risk-averse and your accounting is meticulous, accurate and consistent. You like to get it done the right way the first time around. Big picture thinking is essential.

- Be great to work with: we’re looking for someone who embodies the HeadBox values of brilliance, integrity, empathy, curiosity. We need someone independent, flexible, adaptable and ready to get stuck-in. 

- Growth mindset: you love staying abreast of the latest tools, techniques and equipment in your area of focus and you're happy to share your intel with the team.

- Loyalty: we're big on people who get what we do, why we're doing it and those who genuinely want to be part of something that is shaking up markets that are steeped in old-fashioned ways. You're in it for the long haul, just like the rest of the crew.



Toolbox

Experience in the following is highly desirable as you will be using these tools to do your job:

- MS Office (Word, Excel, PPT) AND Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides) - Advance experience

- Xero (Accounting Software) 



In the course of the role, you will also be exposed the other tech tools we use, which include:

- HubDoc (Document Collection & Management Software)

- Stripe (Online Payment Processing Software)

- Hubspot (Customer Relationship Management Software)

- HeadBox (Our own proprietary Software)

title: Marketing Lead (GoHighLevel & Funnels)
description:
IMPORTANT: To apply for this role, please do not use the platform button. Apply directly through our portal here: 





Location: Remote (Offshore / Outside UK)

Working Hours: Full-Time, UK Business Hours (GMT)

Compensation: £750 – £1,000 per month (Depending on experience)

Key Tools: GoHighLevel (GHL), Asana, Google Workspace

Reports To: Chief Executive / Leadership Team



About Generation Success



Millions of young people face the toughest route into work in a generation. Talent is everywhere—opportunity is not. Generation Success is an award-winning social enterprise on a mission to change that. We partner with employers to build inclusive talent pipelines and connect young people with career-changing opportunities.



We are launching Generation Success 2.0—a complete rebrand and repositioning. We have an established tech stack, a library of content assets, and supporting tea
mbers. Now, we need a focused, execution-minded  Marketing Lead to help us build, tweak, and run a high-converting lead generation engine.



The Role: What You Will Own



This is a hands-on technical and creative execution role. You won't be expected to sit in endless corporate strategy meetings; instead, you will own the day-to-day setup, testing, and optimization of our marketing funnels. If you love working inside GoHighLevel, writing sharp copy, and watching conversion numbers go up, this is for you.



Key Responsibilities:



Funnel & Page Building: Build, launch, and update landing pages and forms primarily within GoHighLevel (GHL) to drive event registrations, volunteer sign-ups, and corporate B2B leads.

Conversion Optimization: Review user journeys, run A/B tests on headlines or layouts, and remove friction points that cause users to drop off.

Campaign Execution & Copywriting: Write compelling digital copy for landing pages, automated
 sequences, and registration workflows that build trust and drive action.

Workflow Coordination: Work alongside our GHL automation specialist and social media assistants to ensure assets are delivered on time, organizing tasks transparently in Asana.

Performance Tracking: Keep an eye on clean data. Track conversion rates, cost-per-lead, and registration metrics to see what is working and what needs tweaking.



What We Are Looking For (Requirements)



GoHighLevel (GHL) Experience: You must be comfortable navigating GHL, building pages, and understanding how forms and workflows connect.

Conversion-Led Mindset: Experience building digital assets explicitly designed to get people to take action (applications, sign-ups, or downloads).

Friction Spotting: The ability to look at a messy landing page or a long form and immediately know how to simplify it for a better user experience.

Organized Remote Worker: Comfortable managing your own daily tasks and timelines transparently in a remote environment using Asana.

Mission Alignment: A genuine interest in social mobility, equal opportunity, and youth empowerment.



What Success Looks Like (Your First 90 Days)



Day 1–30 (Learn & Audit): Get familiar with our mission, our target audiences, and our existing GHL infrastructure. Map out the current funnels and spot the quick wins.

Day 31–60 (Build & Tweak): Optimize the first wave of landing pages, clean up the messaging, and establish a smooth execution rhythm with the support team.

Day 61–90 (Run & Scale): Confidently manage the funnel deployment process, showing steady, measurable improvements in our sign-up and lead conversion rates.



This Role is NOT For You If:



- You are looking for a high-level "consultant" or advisory role where you don't build pages or write copy yourself.

- You measure marketing success by social media likes and follower counts rather than real registrations and leads.

- You prefer loose, unstructured workflows over documented processes and data accountability.



How to Apply



If you are ready to jump into an established ecosystem, optimize high-impact funnels, and make a meaningful difference, we want to hear from you.



Please submit your application, including your CV and links to examples of landing pages or funnels you have built, directly through our portal:

title: Video Editor for Live Events — Event Recaps & Social Content (DaVinci Resolve Preferred, AI-Forward Workflow)
description:
# Video Editor for Live Events — Event Recaps & Social Content (DaVinci Resolve Preferred, AI-Forward Workflow)



**Type of work:** Project-based (per event)

**Hours per week:** Varies with event schedule — typically 10–30 hours during active projects

**Compensation:** $900–$1,200/month USD at typical event volume, paid per event package, based on experience



---



**IMPORTANT: Start your application with the code word STORYLINE so we know you read this in full. Applications without the code word will not be reviewed.**



---



## A Note From Our Founder



Our productions tell stories that matter — nonprofits, mission-driven organizations, conferences that move people. We need a video editor who understands that the edit is where those stories either land or get lost. If you care about craft, deadlines are non-negotiable for you, and you get genuinely excited about new tools instead of threatened by them, this is your seat.



— Artem Nikulkov, Founder



## Who We Are



Earth Coast Productions is a Colorado-based live events and media production company with 15 years of experience. We specialize in live broadcasting, livestreaming, and full AV production for nonprofits, mission-driven organizations, and B-Corps. Every production we deliver is built around one idea: the content from a single event should fuel a brand's story for months.



## How We Work



**Editing at ECP starts with emotion, not footage.** Before the first cut, our editors name the emotion the piece needs to produce, and every select, trim, and pacing decision gets tested against it. Setup grounds the viewer, the emotional core carries the runtime, the meaning lands the close. A technically clean cut with dead energy loses to a slightly looser one that is alive — and a pause that is doing emotional work is content, not dead air. We have written SOPs built around this philosophy, and you will be trained on them. If this way of thinking about the edit resonates with you, you will fit here.



We are also an AI-forward shop, and this is not a buzzword for us — it is how the pipeline actually runs. We already use tools like Claude Code, OpusClip, and Eddie AI in our workflow, and as new AI-native video tools come online, we WILL fold them into our process. You do not need to know every tool on day one. You do need to be curious, adaptable, and quick to learn — the editor who thrives here is the one who asks "what can this do for the edit?" instead of "why are we changing things again?"



We edit in DaVinci Resolve, and we give preference to editors who do too. Strong Premiere editors willing to work in Resolve will be considered, but Resolve-native applicants go to the top of the pile.



## What You Will Actually Do



- Edit event recap videos (5–15 minutes) from raw multi-camera footage

- Cut 90-second highlight reels for post-event delivery

- Edit documentary-style interview and testimonial pieces from field-flagged selects — our crews hand off footage with flagged sound bites, multiple takes, and a named target emotion, so you build from organized material, not a raw drive

- Turn each event into a full social content package: vertical clips and reels for Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts

- Add captions, subtitles, motion graphics, lower thirds, and text overlays

- Repurpose keynote 
nts, speaker soundbites, and audience reactions into platform-native short-form content

- Learn and adopt new AI-native editing tools as we integrate them into the pipeline

- Manage file organization and delivery through our cloud system

- Flag footage issues or missing assets before the edit begins

- Communicate proactively on deadlines and deliverable timelines



## What Success Looks Like



- Recap videos delivered within 5 business days of the event

- Highlight reels delivered within 2 weeks of the event

- A complete social clip package (8–12 clips) delivered per event

- Every piece produces its intended emotion and meets ECP's visual and storytelling standard

- New tools in our stack are picked up and put to work, not avoided

- Zero missed deadlines without prior communication

- Proactive communication on every project



## What We Are Looking For



**Required:**



- 2 or more years of professional video editing experience

- Proficiency in DaVinci Resolve strongly preferred — Resolve editors will be given preference over any other NLE

- Proven short-form / social video editing experience (reels, Shorts, TikTok-style cuts, vertical formats)

- Genuine curiosity about AI editing tools and demonstrated willingness to adopt new workflows

- Experience editing event, corporate, or nonprofit video content

- You edit for emotion first: strong instincts for pacing, storytelling, hooks, and what stops the scroll

- Excellent written English

- A modern editing workstation — latest Apple Silicon (M3/M4 or newer) strongly preferred

- At least 10 TB of available storage for project media

- Reliable high-speed internet capable of handling large multi-camera footage transfers



**Nice to have:**



- Documentary, testimonial, or interview-driven editing experience

- Hands-on experience with AI editing tools (e.g., OpusClip, Eddie AI, Descript, CapCut AI features, or similar)

- Fusion or After Effects motion graphics experience beyond basic templates

- Experience with generative AI video tools such as Runway or Firefly

- Familiarity with ClickUp or similar project management tools



## What We Offer



- Competitive per-project rates, reviewed as event volume grows

- Fully remote and async-first work environment

- A front-row seat to an AI-native production pipeline — you will learn tools here most editors have not touched yet

- Direct collaboration with the founder and production team

- Real creative work supporting mission-driven organizations

- Consistent, recurring project flow — not one-off gigs — as ECP's production volume increases



## Red Flags — Do Not Apply If...



- You have never edited event or live production footage

- You have never cut vertical or short-form social content

- You are resistant to AI tools or prefer to keep editing the way you have always done it

- You cut for technical polish while the emotion falls flat

- Your current setup cannot handle multi-camera 4K timelines or store full event archives

- You miss deadlines without communicating ahead of time

- You need constant direction and do not take initiative

- You struggle with feedback or do not iterate quickly

- You are not comfortable working async and independently



## How to Apply



**Start your application with the code word STORYLINE so we know you read this in full. Applications without the code word will not be reviewed.**



Include the following:



1. A link to your portfolio or 2–3 samples — at least one long-form edit AND at least one vertical/social clip

2. A 1–2 minute video introducing yourself and why this role appeals to you

3. Brief answers to these questions:

   - Walk us through your editing process from raw footage to final delivery — and tell us where emotion enters that process.

   - What NLE do you edit in day to day, and what is your proficiency level in DaVinci Resolve specifically?

   - Tell us about a new tool — AI or otherwise — you recently added to your workflow. Why did you adopt it and what changed?



---



**Skill tags (OLJ):** Video Editing, DaVinci Resolve, Short Form Video, Social Media Content Creation, AI Tools

title: RPA Automation Architect (Microsoft Power Automate Desktop)
description:
I am seeking a highly skilled RPA (Robotic Process Automation) developer to build a modular, high-volume media production pipeline. The goal is to automate content creation workflow (scripting, AV mapping, and asset generation) using Microsoft Power Automate Desktop (PAD) or similar simple-to-use free alternatives.



This is a technical build project, not a general administrative role. I need an architect who can design stable, locally-running automation that I can own and maintain.



Core Workflow Requirements

Phase 1 (Scripting): A modular flow that takes a video title/brief, interacts with Gemini via browser UI, and executes a 10-step prompt chain to produce a final script.



Phase 2 (AV Mapping): An automated process that converts the script into a structured AV table (Google Sheets/CSV - then upload to Sheets).



Phase 3 (Asset Generation): A flow that reads the AV table and automates the prompts created with external tools (Video Express/Google Flow/Gemini/Comfy UI/Similar AI tools) to generate assets and apply parallax effects.



Technical Requirements

Expert in Microsoft Power Automate Desktop (PAD): You must have a portfolio of flows you have built.



UI Automation Specialist: You prioritize using UI Elements and CSS Selectors over simple mouse-click coordinates to ensure automation stability when website layouts change.



Robust Logic: You build "defensive" automation that includes error handling—if a page loads slowly or a task fails, the bot should handle it gracefully without crashing.



Modular Architecture: You build clean, logical sub-flows that can be exported, imported, and run independently.



Project Deliverables & Budget

Total Budget: $375 – $500 USD (Milestone-based).



Milestone 1 (Proof of Concept): $150 USD. We will begin by building the Scripting & AV Table Automator. This must be a fully functional tool that I can use on my own machine immediately.



Milestone 2 (Full Build): $250 – $350 USD. Upon successful testing of Milestone 1, we will proceed to the Asset Generation flow.



Deliverables: Raw .flow source files and a brief setup guide/video showing me how to import and initialize the flows on my local workstation.



How to Apply

To be considered, please provide the following in your application:



Proof of Skill: A screenshot of a complex flow you have built in Power Automate Desktop, or a link to a video demonstrating a bot you created. (Applications without this will be ignored).



Methodology: Briefly explain how you ensure a PAD flow remains stable when a website interface updates.



Confirm Ability: Can you provide .flow files and assist with a remote import process?

title: Youtube Strategist/ Channel Manager
description:
Market Leaders' socials - study before applying:


 




 



WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT



Most "YouTube manager" roles are upload monkeys. You're handed a finished video, you slap on a title someone else wrote, you publish, you log off.



Market Leaders doesn't work that way.



We have the cameras, the editors, and the founders who know the material cold. What we don't have is one person who owns the **thinking** — the person who d
 what we make, why anyone would click, and whether the channel actually grows.



That's you.



You are not here to edit. You are here to run the engine. You plan the slate with the team, you brief the people who shoot and edit, you write the titles and direct the thumbnails that d
 whether a video lives or dies, and you read the analytics like a scoreboard.



If you've grown a channel before and you think in CTR, retention, and packaging — not just in pretty cuts — read on.



This is a fully remote role for someone who wants to own a number, not wait for instructions.



ABOUT MARKET LEADERS



Market Leaders is a Singapore-based social media consulting company. We help high-performing operators — property agents doing $500M+ in deals, financial advisors with established ad systems, business owners building real personal brands — turn their expertise into content that compounds.



We teach the 5 C's: Character, Content, Community, Convert, Client. We believe in systems, not willpower. Peaceful and profitable. World-class, no compromise.



This role is for **our own channels** — the Market Leaders brand channel plus our founders' long-form. You're building the flagship that proves what we teach. The bar is set.



TOTAL COMPENSATION PACKAGE



**Base Salary:** SGD $2,000/month



**What's Included**

- Fully remote — work from anywhere, as long as you overlap Singapore working hours (SGT)

- Direct line to the founders and the content team you'll be directing

- Market Leaders training on hooks, packaging, retention, and short-form/long-form strategy

- The tools you need to do the job (analytics, scheduling, thumbnail collaboration, AI ideation)

- Ownership of a real channel's growth number — not a faceless task queue



**Work Benefits**

- Results-focused, not clock-watching — we judge the channel's numbers, not your hours online

- Clear monthly scoreboard so you always know where you stand

- Real budget exposure: your packaging gets tested with real distribution



**Path Forward**

- Prove you can grow the number, and the scope grows with you — more channels, a bigger team to direct, and a senior content-lead track

- This is a long-term seat for the right operator, not a gig

THE 4Rs — YOUR ROLE BREAKDOWN



### 1. ROLE — The Mission



Own Market Leaders' long-form YouTube engine end to end.



You plan what we make, you direct the team that films and edits it, you package it so people click and stay, and you grow the channel on the strength of the analytics. You are the brain of the operation — the editors are the hands.



Every video serves a business objective:

- Position Market Leaders and our founders as the trusted authority in their space

- Earn the click (title + thumbnail) and hold the watch (structure + pacing)

- Turn our frameworks and founder insight into long-form people actually finish

- Feed the short-form machine — every long-form becomes Shorts and cross-platform clips



You will use AI to ideate and research faster, but the taste and the calls are yours.



### 2. RESPONSIBILITIES — The Day-to-Day Work



**Strategy & Ideation — 30%**

- Plan the monthly long-form slate *with the team* — what we make, in what order, and why

- Research topics, search demand, and competitor channels to find angles worth filming

- Turn founder material and frameworks into clear briefs and outlines the team can shoot

- Bring a point of view to every video: who it's for, the hook, the payoff



**Packaging — Titles & Thumbnails — 25%**

- Write multiple title options per video and test them — this is the single biggest CTR lever

- Direct thumbnail concepts (brief the designer; you own the concept, not the Photoshop)

- Own click-through rate as a metric you're personally accountable for

- Keep a swipe file of what's working and feed it back into the next slate



**Production Direction — 25%**

- Brief the shooters and editors against your outline, then QC the cut against the brief

- Run the content calendar and pipeline so videos ship on a predictable cadence

- Unblock the team, chase what's stuck, and keep the machine moving

- Maintain a repeatable production system, not one-off heroics



**Channel Management & Analytics — 20%**

- Publish with proper titles, descriptions, tags, chapters, end-screens, and playlists

- Live in YouTube Studio: read CTR, average view duration, retention curves, and traffic sources

- Turn each long-form into Shorts and repurpose across Instagram, TikTok, and LinkedIn

- Report the numbers and the next move — what we'll change and why



### 3. RESULTS — What Success Looks Like



**Foundation Phase — Month 1**

- Know the channels, the founders' voices, and the back catalogue cold

- Ship the first slate you planned end to end — briefed, filmed, edited, packaged, published

- Stand up a working content calendar and a titles/thumbnails packaging system

- Establish the baseline: current CTR, AVD, and retention, so we know what we're improving



*This phase is about learning the brand, the material, and the team rhythm.*



**Growth Phase — Month 3**

- Hold a consistent publishing cadence with no missed weeks

- Show a measurable lift in CTR and/or average view duration vs. baseline

- Run a repeatable packaging system the team can follow without you in every detail

- Reliably turn each long-form into Shorts and cross-platform clips



*This phase is where you stop reacting and start driving the channel.*



**Long-Term Impact — Month 6**

- Own the channel number — views, subscribers, retention — with minimal founder input

- Direct the team to ship the slate on cadence while you stay focused on strategy + packaging

- Demonstrate channel growth attributable to your packaging and slate decisions

- Be trusted to take on more channels and a bigger team



*This phase is where the channel runs as a system you own, not a series of one-offs.*



### 4. REQUIREMENTS — The Must-Haves



**Experience**

- Demonstrable track record growing a YouTube channel (yours or a client's) — show the before/after

- Hands-on experience writing and testing titles and directing thumbnails for CTR

- Experience directing a remote content team (editors, designers, shooters) against briefs

- Strong grasp of long-form structure, hooks, and retention — and how Shorts feed the main channel



**Skills**

- Fluent in YouTube Studio analytics — CTR, AVD, retention, traffic sources, and what to do about each

- Comfortable using AI tools for ideation, research, scripting support, and repurposing

- Strong written and spoken English — you'll be briefing a team and the founders daily

- Comfortable with a project-management tool (Notion, Asana, ClickUp, or similar)



**Work Arrangement**

- Fully remote, but you must overlap core Singapore working hours (SGT) for briefs and reviews

- Reliable laptop and internet — you run the pipeline, you can't drop offline

- Able to commit long-term, not a short gig between other things



**Work Style**

- Ownership mentality — you treat the channel's growth like your own business

- Self-managed — nobody is going to watch over your shoulder; the numbers do that

- Decisive on packaging — you form opinions and test them, you don't wait to be told

- Open to feedback and fast iteration — you'd rather hear "this missed" than "this is fine"



WHAT MAKES YOU THE PERFECT FIT



**You Think in Numbers, Not Just Aesthetics**

You don't ask "is the video done?" You ask "will this title earn the click, and will the first 30 seconds keep them?" CTR and retention are your scoreboard.



**You've Actually Grown a Channel**

You can point to a channel you moved — views, subs, watch time — and explain *why* it grew. You know the difference between a video that got lucky and a system that compounds.



**You Direct Without Doing It All Yourself**

You're comfortable handing the camera and the timeline to the team and getting what you wanted through a clear brief and honest QC. You scale through people, not through your own keyboard.



**You Live in the Packaging**

You have opinions on titles and thumbnails. You can look at any channel and explain what you'd change to lift the click. You collect what works.



**You Use AI to Move Faster**

You're not scared of AI. You use it to research, ideate, and repurpose faster — and you know it sharpens your taste, it doesn't replace it.



**You Communicate Proactively**

A remote team only works if you flag things early. If footage is weak, you say so. If the slate's slipping, you raise it before it's a problem.



**You Crave Improvement**

You don't take a flat video personally. You read the retention graph, find the drop-off, and fix it next time.



HOW TO APPLY

**1.
**

Send your application to: 

Subject line: **Client Support / Account Manager — [Your Name]**



AND 



Fill out this form:

We are a fast growing DTC women's wellness brand. Our customers aren't just buying a supplement. A lot of them are going through something really personal. - Experience with Shopify and Richpanel, Gorgias, Zendesk, or Re:amaze

- Background in supplements, beauty, wellness, or women's health

- Experience handling subscriptions (cancellations, skips, swaps)

- Familiarity with 3PL coordination or order tracking troubleshooting

- Salary: $750/month base, plus performance bonuses when you hit all KPIs (we'll walk you through exactly what those look like)

How to apply

Please send us three things:



1. Your updated CV

2. Your OnlineJobs.ph profile link

A quick intro about yourself

- Your CX experience and the brands or platforms you've worked with

- Why you think you'd be a great fit for Bloom & Bond

Looking forward to meeting you

*Monitor active shipments to ensure on-time pickup and delivery.

*Contact carriers and drivers to obtain real-time shipment status updates.

*Accurately update the Transportation Management System (TMS) with shipment milestones and notes.

*Proactively identify delays, service failures, or potential disruptions and escalate issues promptly.

*Communicate shipment updates to customers, account managers, and operations staff.

*Verify pickup and delivery appointments and confirm completion.

*Maintain detailed documentation of all shipment communications.

*Support dispatch and operations teams during periods of high shipment volume.

*Ensure compliance with company procedures and customer service standards.





Qualifications

*Previous experience in freight brokerage, logistics, transportation,  preferred.

*Strong verbal and written communication skills.

*Excellent organizational and multitasking abilities.

*Ability to work in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

*Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills.

*Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Outlook, Excel, Word).

*Experience using TMS software is a plus.



Preferred Skills

*Knowledge of truckload transportation and freight brokerage operations.

*Ability to build positive relationships with carriers and internal teams.

*Comfortable making a high volume of outbound phone calls.

*Strong time management and follow-through.



Benefits

Competitive pay

Paid time off and holidays

Opportunities for career growth and advancement

Supportive and collaborative work environment



Why Join Our Team?



You'll play a vital role in keeping freight moving while helping customers receive timely, accurate updates. If you're organized, enjoy solving problems, and thrive in a fast-paced logistics environment, we'd love to hear from you.



Apply today and become an essential part of our operations team! Please send over your resume and answer the below vetting questions! 



1) Do you have track and trace experience already at a freight brokerage?

2) How many years of total experience do you have in Logistics

title: Senior Financial Analyst with Audit experience - fixed-term contract (6 months)
description:
Who is Bare?



Bare is one of Australia’s fastest growing businesses, in one of the most traditional industries in the world — the funeral industry.



We exist to make end-of-life care accessible, affordable and transparent, changing the way Australians deal with death. For too long, the industry has delivered expensive, traditional, cookie-cutter services that don’t reflect how modern Australians want to say goodbye.



By combining empathy with technology, we’re creating end-of-life experiences that are simple, personalised and affordable. In just five years, we’ve supported more than 40,000 families, become Australia’s most awarded end-of-life provider (recognised for customer service, innovation and digital disruption), and built a team of 100+ passionate people.



And we’re just getting started.



As part of our continued growth, we’re looking for a Senior Financial Analyst to join our finance team.



So, what’s the role?



This is not your typical Senior Financial Analyst role. We offer a fixed-term contract (6 months). You’ll work closely with our VP Finance and senior leadership team, helping to drive financial insight and discipline across one of Australia’s fastest growing companies.



You’ll play a key role in financial analysis, reporting, forecasting and business partnering, turning financial data into meaningful insights that support smart commercial decisions.



This is a hands-on role in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, ideal for someone who enjoys digging into the numbers, improving processes, and influencing business decisions.



You’ll be responsible for:



-Prepare monthly and ad hoc financial reports, including P&L, gross profit, EBITDA, and cash flow analysis. Lead month-end and year-end closing processes, ensuring accuracy and timeliness of financial data. Deliver clear variance analysis, trend insights, and key KPIs such as LTV/CAC and other commercial metrics to support business decision-making.

-Owning the budgeting and forecasting processes across multiple entities

-Building and maintaining financial models to support planning and decision-making

-Providing financial insights and analysis to support senior leadership and operational teams

-Assisting with reconciliations and financial data accuracy across systems

-Supporting compliance with BAS, PAYGW, FBT and other regulatory requirements

-Assisting with audit preparation and working with external auditors

-Identifying opportunities to improve financial processes and reporting efficiency

-Supporting the implementation of automation, AI tools and improved reporting frameworks

-Report to Finance Manager and working closely with senior stakeholders



What will set you apart from other candidates:



-You’re analytical and commercially minded, able to turn data into meaningful insights

-You enjoy solving problems and improving processes

-You’re comfortable working in fast-paced, high-growth environments

-You’re highly organised and able to manage multiple priorities

-You take ownership and initiative, proactively identifying opportunities for improvement

-You’re curious and interested in leveraging technology and automation in finance

-Strong understanding of key financial metrics: EBITDA, gross profit, cash flow, LTV-CAC



What you’ll bring:



-A Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field

-CPA, CA or CMA qualification (or working towards) highly regarded

-5+ years’ experience in financial analysis, reporting and auditing

-Strong experience with financial reporting, forecasting and variance analysis

-Advanced Excel / financial modelling skills

-Experience with Xero or similar accounting systems

-Strong communication skills and the ability to present financial insights clearly to non-finance stakeholders



What’s in it for you?

This isn’t your ordinary finance role, in your ordinary company. You’ll join an entrepreneurial, inclusive culture where we succeed together. We offer autonomy, flexibility and real ownership. No two days are the same — and that’s exactly how we like it.



In addition, we offer:



-A high-performing and highly engaged team environment

-Autonomy and flexibility, including work-from-home options

-A competitive salary

-The opportunity to help transform an industry and make a real human impact



The main reason you’ll join, however, is because you believe in what we’re building. You’re excited by growth. You want to help scale a business that is genuinely changing lives — and you want your finance expertise to be part of that journey.

About the role

We are looking for a sharp, self-directed Marketing Strategist with a copywriting core to own the backend of our client strategy offer for Australian NDIS providers.

Working from the Director's discovery inputs (client questionnaire, discovery-call transcript, and initial thoughts), you will run the research and synthesis workflow and produce both the client's strategy and the deliverable copy that brings it to life: positioning, offer and service-stack design, go-to-market plan, messaging, lead magnets, and website and ad copy.

This is a strategic and a craft role in equal measure. You d
 who to target and with what angle, and write the deliverables that express it in compelling, on-message, and plain, client-ready language.

This is a non-client-facing, remote role with the opportunity to grow into additional hours and responsibilities over time.



What you’ll be doing

- Running the research and synthesis workflow using AI tools (Claude, Manus, Perplexity) from the Director's discovery pack

- Conducting audience/avatar, market, and competitor research for each client

- Designing positioning, offer, and service-stack strategies for NDIS provider clients

- Developing go-to-market plans, funnels, and lead magnet strategies

- Writing deliverable copy: website copy, ad copy, landing pages, and lead magnets

- Crafting messaging architecture that is compelling and in plain, client-ready language

- Submitting work at the Director's named checkpoints and revising based on feedback

- Keeping multiple client strategies moving to deadline

- Improving the strategy workflow and prompt library over time

- Logging what works and what needs re-prompting across client projects



What we’re looking for

- A marketing strategist with a copywriting core, able to both design the strategy and write the deliverables

- Demonstrated ability to identify a target audience and the angle that wins, and express it in compelling, plain-English copy

- Sharp judgment on what makes copy and campaigns good or bad, and can articulate why

- Experience across positioning, offers and service-stack, go-to-market, and funnels

- Excellent written English with a genuine feel for writing to a Western / Australian audience

- Able to translate marketing concepts into clear, jargon-free language a client understands

- Strong research skills across audience/avatar, market, and competitor analysis

- Self-directed and systems-minded, able to improve a process, not just follow one

- Comfortable orchestrating AI research and synthesis tools (Claude, Manus, Perplexity)

- Strong attention to detail with error-free, on-brief copy

- Able to manage multiple client strategies and deadlines independently



Work setup requirements (non-negotiable)

- Quiet, dedicated workspace

- Reliable internet connection

- High-quality microphone or headset

Australian morning shift

No weekend work

Stable, long-term opportunity

Supportive and collaborative team environment

Opportunity to work on a variety of Australian engineering and manufacturing projects



About the Role

As our CAD Drafter, you'll play an important role in producing detailed technical drawings that support the design, manufacture, and installation of industrial electrical and mechanical systems. You'll work closely with engineers, estimators, and project managers to ensure all documentation is accurate, practical, and ready for production.

Documentation & Coordination

Revise drawings throughout the project lifecycle

Coordinate with engineers, estimators, and project managers

Maintain organized drawing registers and revision history

Ensure documentation complies with project requirements and relevant Australian standards where applicable



What We're Looking For

Proven experience as an Industrial, Electrical, Mechanical, or CAD Drafter

Strong proficiency in AutoCAD or similar CAD software

Experience preparing manufacturing, fabrication, or construction drawings

Excellent attention to detail

Strong written and spoken English communication skills

You'll stand out if you have experience with any of the following:



Australian engineering, manufacturing, or construction projects

Electrical switchboards and control panels

Sheet metal fabrication

Mechanical assemblies

Structural steel detailing

PLC and industrial automation systems

Light Gauge Steel Framing (LGSF/LSF)

Structural timber framing

Facade systems

Material take-offs and Bills of Materials (BOMs)

Australian Standards and the National Construction Code (NCC)



A diploma or degree in Engineering, Drafting, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Architecture, Building Design, or a related discipline is desirable but not essential.

title: Email Marketing Manager — Copy, Design & AI Workflow
description:
HIRING:
 Marketing Manager — Copy, Design & AI Workflow

Full-time | 100% Remote | €1,500/month fixed



EazyFlows is an
 marketing agency serving e-commerce and DTC brands. We're one year old, currently have 8 active clients on Klaviyo, and we're doubling the team over the next months — starting with this role.



We've built an AI-powered setup that turns one person into a three-person output team: Claude for copy and body sections, Higgsfield for image generation, fully integrated. Our founder alone builds 75+
s per day using this setup. That's the standard we set.



This role is a foundation hire. You'll be the first dedicated person for copy and design — the founder steps out of daily execution and focuses on scaling the business. What you build in the first months will shape the agency for years.



What you'll find:



- A young agency still being shaped. Your opinion matters — not just on copy and design, but on processes, tools, and how we work with clients.

- An established AI workflow that makes you 3x faster. No tool chaos, just a well-thought-out system.

- Direct collaboration with the founder. No middle layer, no reporting bureaucracy, no long decision-making chains.

- 8 active clients with clear setups and running campaigns — no cold start.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



You take full ownership of copy and design for all
 campaigns across our client portfolio. Specifically:



- Brand and customer research: voice, angles, USPs, competitors — owned per client.

- Copy creation: hooks, angles, body, CTAs. Written in near-native English. AI-assisted, but with craftsman-level understanding of what actually sells in
s.

- Design in Figma: templates, sections, mobile-first, component-based thinking.

- Image generation with Higgsfield, integrated into our Claude workflow.

- A/B testing and flow optimization: you read the data and turn it into concrete improvements.

- Weekly reporting to the founder: what went live, what's coming, where you need support.



What you WON'T do: Klaviyo implementation and strategy stay with the founder — your focus is copy, design, and research. Your input on strategic questions is welcome, but ownership sits elsewhere.



OUTPUT STANDARD



40 hours per week (8 hours × 5 days). Within that time, you deliver the agreed output. The standard: 75+
s per day using our AI workflow, plus research and flow optimization. That's not a stretch goal — it's the rhythm our setup enables. If you master the tools, you'll get through the week comfortably.



If someone consistently needs significantly more time, they're not using the setup right. We address that early and openly.



NON-NEGOTIABLES



Three things are hard requirements. Without these, we don't read the application:



1. 5-10 years of hands-on experience in
 marketing. Not a junior role, not a career-changer, not "I've written some
s."



2. Agency experience. You've already worked in an agency handling multiple clients in parallel. You know the rhythm, the context-switching, the client language. In-house-only experience doesn't fit here.



3. Honesty and reliability. You say what you'll deliver, then you deliver it. If something's not working, you flag it early. No hiding, no excuses, no inflated timesheets. This role rises and falls with trust — and trust is our hardest requirement.



REQUIREMENTS



- Klaviyo experience in real client environments (not tutorial-level)

- Figma at a professional level (Auto-Layout, component thinking, design systems)

- Daily use of AI tools — Claude or ChatGPT for copy, Higgsfield or similar for images. Not "I've tried it once," but real daily workflow.

- Near-native English writing skill — sales-driven, hook-based, DTC-ready copy

- Design sense: hierarchy, whitespace, mobile-first, clean aesthetic

- Independent working style — you get the week, not the day mapped out for you

- Clear, proactive communication in Slack and Loom

- Availability with at least 4 hours of daily overlap with Central European Time (CET) for real-time coordination



COMPENSATION & SETUP



- €1,500 fixed / month as freelance/contract arrangement

- Monthly payment against invoice

- All tools provided by us: Klaviyo, Figma, Claude, Higgsfield — including onboarding to our existing setup

- Performance bonus for significant growth contribution. Concretely: if your work multiplies the business, we make sure you feel it financially. Structure discussed individually.

- 100% remote, work from anywhere

- Growth perspective: the agency is young. Whoever proves themselves will grow into one of our first leadership positions — Team Lead, Marketing Manager, Head of Marketing are realistic paths.



APPLICATION



Send your application with the following in the subject line:



FLASCHENKOPF



Applications without this codeword won't be reviewed. It's our first attention filter.



Please include:



- CV or LinkedIn profile

- Portfolio with 3-5 real
 examples from your agency work — screenshots or live links, with short notes on client, goal, result

- Short cover letter: why you, why this role, why EazyFlows

- Bonus: a concrete example of how you used AI (Claude, ChatGPT, Higgsfield) in real client workflow — what was the task, how did you use the tools, what was the result

- If available: numbers from past roles (open rates, CTR, revenue attribution)



WHAT HAPPENS NEXT



1. First call (30-45 min) with the founder — get to know each other, fit check, role details

2. Paid test task — one real campaign for one of our clients

3. Deep-dive call — technical, strategic, open questions from both sides

4. Offer and start



We're looking for someone for the next years, not the next three months. If you read this and think "this is exactly what I've been wanting to do — just without the chaos I usually see," you're probably in the right place.



Looking forward to your application.

title: Senior Commercial Real Estate Financial Analyst (U.S. CRE)
description:
Job Type: Full-Time (40 hours/week)

Location: Remote (Philippines)

Schedule: Semi-flexible, typically 3:00 PM – 12:00 AM Manila Time





About Us



We are a well-funded and fast-growing FinTech company founded by industry leaders from Wall Street and Silicon Valley. Our mission is to transform how commercial real estate financial data is processed through advanced technology, automation, and artificial intelligence.



As part of our continued growth, we’re building a team of experienced Commercial Real Estate professionals who can accurately interpret complex U.S. CRE financial documents and transform them into high-quality structured datasets that power next-generation AI models.







About the Role



We are seeking a Senior Commercial Real Estate Financial Analyst with a strong background in U.S. Commercial Real Estate accounting, underwriting, and financial analysis.



This role goes beyond document review. You will analyze and validate financial information from commercial real estate documents, ensuring accuracy and consistency while applying your accounting and financial expertise to interpret complex transactions.



The ideal candidate has extensive experience working with T12 operating statements, rent rolls, loan agreements, property financial statements, and underwriting packages for U.S. commercial real estate assets.







Key Responsibilities



    * Review and analyze U.S. Commercial Real Estate financial documents, including:

    * Trailing Twelve Month (T12) Operating Statements

    * Property Profit & Loss Statements

    * Balance Sheets

    * Rent Rolls

    * Loan Agreements

    * Freddie Mac and Fannie Mae loan documents

    * Offering Memorandums (OMs)

    * Purchase & Sale Agreements

    * Appraisal Reports

    * Property Financial Statements

* Interpret financial data and ensure information is accurately extracted and validated.

* Analyze financial metrics including:

    * Net Operating Income (NOI)

    * Debt Service Coverage Ratio (DSCR)

    * Capitalization Rate (Cap Rate)

    * Occupancy

    * Operating Expenses

    * Effective Gross Income (EGI)

    * Debt Service

    * Cash Flow

* Identify discrepancies, anomalies, and inconsistencies across multiple financial documents.

* Validate extracted financial data using accounting principles and CRE best practices.

* Organize and maintain structured datasets used for AI model training.

* Collaborate with internal teams to improve extraction accuracy and document review processes.

* Maintain the highest standards of quality, confidentiality, and data integrity.





Required Qualifications



Experience



* Minimum 5 years of professional experience in U.S. Commercial Real Estate.

* Background in Accounting, Finance, Commercial Real Estate, Asset Management, Underwriting, or Commercial Lending.

* Experience analyzing U.S. Commercial Real Estate financial statements.

* Hands-on experience reviewing T12 Operating Statements is required.

* Experience reviewing Rent Rolls is required.

* Experience reviewing Loan Agreements and financing documents.

* Experience supporting underwriting, acquisitions, asset management, lending, or due diligence.

* This role is not suitable for junior analysts.







Technical Skills



Must have strong understanding of:



* U.S. Commercial Real Estate

* Multifamily properties

* Property accounting

* Financial statement analysis

* Commercial lending

* Underwriting

* GAAP accounting fundamentals

* NOI

* DSCR

* Cap Rate

* Debt Service

* Cash Flow Analysis

* Rent Roll Analysis

* T12 Financial Analysis





Excel & Analytical Skills



Advanced Microsoft Excel skills are required, including:



* Pivot Tables

* XLOOKUP / INDEX-MATCH

* SUMIFS

* Logical formulas

* Financial calculations

* Data validation

* Large dataset analysis



You should be highly analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable working with complex financial datasets.





Preferred Qualifications



Experience with any of the following is highly desirable:



* Freddie Mac

* Fannie Mae

* CMBS loans

* Yardi

* RealPage

* MRI

* Argus Enterprise

* CoStar

* Commercial loan servicing

* CRE acquisitions

* Multifamily underwriting

* Asset management





Ideal Candidate



We’re looking for someone who can confidently answer YES to most of the following:



* ? I have an accounting or finance background.

* ? I’ve analyzed U.S. Commercial Real Estate financial statements.

* ? I’ve worked with T12 Operating Statements.

* ? I’ve analyzed Rent Rolls.

* ? I’ve reviewed Loan Agreements.

* ? I’m comfortable calculating and interpreting NOI, DSCR, and Cap Rates.

* ? I have advanced Excel skills.

* ? I’ve supported underwriting, acquisitions, lending, or asset management.

* ? I can identify inconsistencies across multiple financial documents.

* ? I’m comfortable working with large volumes of financial data while maintaining exceptional accuracy.





Compensation



Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.

Continuously upgrades job knowledge and emotional control.

Asks questions, communicates clearly, takes ownership and dedicated to winning.

Great written and verbal communication skills.

Take massive action to get things done.

KinderBuild Pte Ltd is a Singapore-based specialist contractor delivering playgrounds, safety surfacing, and outdoor fitness equipment for MCSTs, international schools, and childcare operators. We're looking for a 3D Playground Designer to join our team on a part-time basis.

Scope of work:



Convert site measurements/scans into 3D playground layout designs

Produce client-ready 3D proposal renderings for each project, with a minimum of 4–6 perspective views per design, each set against a realistic site background/context (not blank/plain renders)

Ensure all designs are compliant with Singapore playground safety standards — SS 457 and EN 1176 (fall zones, critical fall height, entrapment/entanglement clearances, age-appropriate zoning, etc.)

Revise designs based on client and internal feedback in a timely manner



Standard workflow:



KinderBuild provides site scan/measurements, equipment list, and layout brief

Designer produces a draft 3D layout for internal review

Once layout is approved, designer completes full renders (4–6 perspective views with background) plus any requested revisions

Final files handed over in agreed format for client proposal use



Requirements:



Proficiency in 3D design software (e.g. SketchUp, 3ds Max, Blender, or similar)

Willingness to learn and apply SS 457 / EN 1176 playground safety standards (training/guidance will be provided)

Good eye for realistic rendering — lighting, landscaping, and site context

Able to work independently and turn around designs within agreed timelines



Nice to have:



Prior experience with playground, landscape, or architectural visualization

Familiarity with Polycam or other 3D scanning tools



Interested applicants:

Please
 
 with your portfolio/sample work and a short trial piece (a sample playground render) for consideration.

title: Creative Coordinator
description:

Compensation: $1,200 – $1,800/month (40h/week), paid on time, every time



---



About Us



We're a fast-growing e-commerce brand group operating multiple successful brands. Our flagship brand is Luuma (
), a German-market skincare brand built on high-volume paid social advertising across
, Instagram, and TikTok.

Nice to Have:



- Familiarity with ElevenLabs, MakeUGC, Higgsfield, Notion, or Slack

- Interest in social media advertising or content creation



---



What We Offer



- $1,200 – $1,800/month for 40 hours/week — paid on time, every time

- A stable, long-term full-time position, not a short-term project

- Full training and SOPs provided for every task — no guessing, ever

- A collaborative team that supports each other and shares learnings openly

- One team call per week to stay aligned across all brands

- Room to grow — tea
mbers who prove themselves take on more responsibility over time

---



How to Apply



Click Apply on this post to submit your application. Please include your salary expectation and a short note on your relevant experience. We review every application personally and will reach out to suitable candidates directly.

title: YouTube Video Editor
description:
About the role:

---------------------

We run Voyager, a YouTube channel that investigates the great unsolved mysteries of math, science, and engineering. Our videos are rigorously researched and told as stories, so any curious person feels both the awe of the unknown and the satisfaction of finally understanding it. Our editing style prioritizes clarity, accuracy, and detail over flashy effects — every graphic earns its place by making an abstract idea easier to understand.



You'll work directly with our two founders/creative directors on a channel with 7k+ subscribers and 450k+ views.

See our style on our YouTube 



What you'll do:

---------------------

Edit 2–3 long-form videos per month (typically 20–25 min each), roughly one finished video per week. A full edit includes: assembly and pacing from provided A-roll and script, color grading, sound design (compression, EQ, music selection), B-roll sourcing, motion graphics/animations, and maintaining a cohesive brand look throughout.



You're a fit if you have:

---------------------

Proven experience editing long-form YouTube videos with a strong grasp of YouTube pacing and storytelling (think Johnny Harris, Vox, Cleo Abram, 3Blue1Brown)

Proficiency in DaVinci Resolve (Studio not required)

Ability to create motion graphics and simple animations

Comfort sourcing B-roll and doing sound design (compression, EQ, licensed music)

Fluent English and experience working async in a remote team

Bonus: a background or strong interest in math, engineering, or physics



Expectations:

---------------------

One finished 20–25 min video per week

Weekly 1-hour call with the creative directors

Consistent deadlines; up to 3 revision rounds per video included

Async communication over WhatsApp, replies within 24 hours on workdays



Rate:

---------------------

$10 per finished minute — most videos run 20–25 min, so roughly $200–$250 per video, paid per video on delivery. Included revision rounds are covered by the per-minute rate. Performance-based bonuses available.



How to apply:

---------------------

Step 1 — Reply by answering the following questions:

1. In two or three sentences, tell us one YouTube channel whose editing you admire and why.

2. Do you have a background or strong interest in math, science, or engineering? Tell us briefly.

3. Link to your portfolio/reel/channel/Resume

4. Link 1-2 long form YouTube Videos you have personally edited. (Send Youtube link ONLY) 



Step 2 — Paid trial edit. Selected candidates will be invited to a paid trial ($20) — a short intro video plus a 2-minute edited clip using our actual footage, which we'll send you directly. This is where we see how you work with our material.



Step 3 — Final interview. Candidates whose trial stands out meet with our creative directors, Madeline and Aditya, to talk through the edit, working style, and the role.
