title: Video editor,. Time Stamp
description:
# Podcast & Short-Form Video Editor (Story-Driven)



## About the Role



We're looking for an editor with a storyteller's instinct — someone who can take hours of raw footage, transcripts, or a list of rough timestamps and *find the 
nts that matter*. This isn't about mechanically trimming silence and slapping on captions. We want someone who watches for the laugh, the tension, the turn of phrase that makes a clip worth sharing — and then edits with pacing, motion, and sound design to bring that 
nt to life.



You'll handle full-length podcast episodes end-to-end, then mine that same raw footage for short-form clips that actually stop the scroll. If you love finding the story hiding inside unedited footage as much as you love a clean audio mix, this is for you.



## Responsibilities



- **Find the story first**: review raw footage, transcripts, or timestamp notes to identify the strongest 
nts — compelling soundbites, emotional beats, funny exchanges, quotable lines — before cutting

- Edit full-length podcast episodes: cutting, pacing, noise reduction, and audio mixing

- Cut short-form content (Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts) from long-form episodes that feels alive, not just trimmed — with editing choices, sound, and motion that add energy

- Create motion graphics (lower thirds, titles, transitions, animated text, dynamic captions) that enhance the story rather than decorate it

- Color grade video footage for a consistent, professional look

- Maintain consistent branding and visual style across all video output

- Collaborate with the team on creative direction, format ideas, and turnaround timelines



## Requirements



- Proven experience editing podcasts (audio and/or video)

- A strong eye for narrative — able to spot the best 
nt in raw, unstructured footage without being told exactly where to look

- Strong motion graphics skills (titles, animated lower thirds, kinetic typography, etc.)

- Proficiency in color grading

- Fluent in spoken and written English

- Proficient in Adobe Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve (required)

- Experience editing short-form, vertical video content for social platforms

- Strong sense of pacing, rhythm, and storytelling for both audio and video

- Reliable, detail-oriented, and able to meet deadlines consistently



## Nice to Have



- Experience with After Effects for advanced motion graphics

- Familiarity with audio tools like Audacity, Adobe Audition, or iZotope RX

- A portfolio or demo reel showing a clear "before and after" — raw footage vs. finished clip — so we can see your eye for a 
nt, not just your technical skill



## To Apply



- Tell us a bit about yourself — who you are, your editing background, and what kind of content you love working on

- Send a portfolio or demo reel. We're especially interested in examples where you turned raw, unremarkable footage into a clip that felt genuinely worth watching — show us the 
nt you found, not just the edit

- This role requires a strong grasp of English, including American humor and banter — you'll need to recognize a joke, a sarcastic aside, or comedic timing in raw footage to know it's worth cutting

title: Web Developer
description:
We are looking for a Web Developer with strong SEO awareness to build, optimize, and maintain high-performance websites that scale in search visibility and technical quality.



You will work closely with SEO strategists, content teams, and designers to ensure that websites are crawlable, indexable, fast, and semantically structured, while maintaining clean code and excellent user experience.



Responsibilities

 • Develop and maintain websites with SEO-first architecture and clean HTML structure

 • Implement technical SEO best practices (Core Web Vitals, crawl efficiency, indexing control)

 • Optimize page speed, rendering, and server responses (CWV, lazy loading, caching)

 • Ensure proper use of semantic HTML (H1–H6 hierarchy, internal linking, contextual components)

 • Implement and maintain structured data (JSON-LD)

 • Work with log files, redirects, canonicals, pagination, and hreflang

 • Collaborate with SEO teams on scalable, programmatic page generation

 • Identify and fix technical SEO issues across large websites



Requirements

 • Strong experience with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and modern web standards

 • Experience with WordPress or similar CMS platforms

 • Solid understanding of technical SEO fundamentals

 • Familiarity with Core Web Vitals, Lighthouse, and PageSpeed Insights

 • Ability to work on large websites with thousands of URLs

 • Attention to detail and clean, maintainable code practices



Nice to Have

 • Experience with programmatic SEO or large-scale content systems

 • Knowledge of server-side rendering, caching layers, or CDN setups

 • Familiarity with SEO tools (Search Console, log analysis, crawlers)



This role is ideal for a developer who understands that code quality, performance, and SEO are deeply connected, and wants to build websites that perform well both for users and search engines.

nts of a conversation.

-You understand that being the first voice someone hears can directly impact a company's success.
